FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY rate ASC
LIMIT 3

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM (
        SELECT Segment,
               CustomerID,
               total_consumption,
               MIN(total_consumption) OVER (PARTITION BY Segment) AS min_total
        FROM czk_2013
    )
    WHERE total_consumption = min_total
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

    SELECT MIN(losses)

WITH m AS (
    SELECT * FROM Match
    WHERE country_id = (SELECT id FROM Country WHERE name = 'Italy')
),
pids AS (
    SELECT home_player_1 AS pid FROM m
    UNION SELECT home_player_2 FROM m
    UNION SELECT home_player_3 FROM m
    UNION SELECT home_player_4 FROM m
    UNION SELECT home_player_5 FROM m
    UNION SELECT home_player_6 FROM m
    UNION SELECT home_player_7 FROM m
    UNION SELECT home_player_8 FROM m
    UNION SELECT home_player_9 FROM m
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM m
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM m
    UNION SELECT away_player_1 FROM m
    UNION SELECT away_player_2 FROM m
    UNION SELECT away_player_3 FROM m
    UNION SELECT away_player_4 FROM m
    UNION SELECT away_player_5 FROM m
    UNION SELECT away_player_6 FROM m
    UNION SELECT away_player_7 FROM m
    UNION SELECT away_player_8 FROM m
    UNION SELECT away_player_9 FROM m
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM m
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM m
)
SELECT AVG(height) AS avg_height
FROM Player
WHERE player_api_id IN (SELECT pid FROM pids);

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_inpatient,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_outpatient,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

WITH annual AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID,
           c.Segment,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_cons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM annual
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_cons AS (
    SELECT a.Segment,
           SUM(a.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.CustomerID) AS avg_annual
    FROM annual a
    JOIN min_cons m
      ON a.Segment = m.Segment
     AND a.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY a.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_annual FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT avg_annual FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_annual FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT avg_annual FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_annual FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT avg_annual FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

             WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id 
               AND t.k_symbol = 'U'), 0)
        ELSE 0
    END AS remaining_debt,
    l.payments AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration,
    l.status,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Contract finished, no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Contract finished, loan not paid'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Contract running, payments OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Contract running, client in debt'

WITH per_cust AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           y.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM per_cust
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT p.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(p.total) AS total_sum,
           COUNT(p.CustomerID) AS cnt
    FROM per_cust p
    JOIN min_per_seg m ON p.Segment = m.Segment AND p.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT total_sum / cnt FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT total_sum / cnt FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS "SME-LAM",
    (SELECT total_sum / cnt FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT total_sum / cnt FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS "LAM-KAM",
    (SELECT total_sum / cnt FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT total_sum / cnt FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS "KAM-SME";

WITH bond_elem AS (
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element
                THEN a1.element || a2.element
                ELSE a2.element || a1.element
           END AS elem_combo
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
),
combo_counts AS (
    SELECT elem_combo, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM bond_elem
    GROUP BY elem_combo
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN be.elem_combo =
                          (SELECT elem_combo
                           FROM combo_counts
                           ORDER BY cnt DESC
                           LIMIT 1)
                     THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM bond_elem be;

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    SELECT pc.Segment, SUM(pc.total_consumption) / COUNT(pc.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM per_customer pc
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON pc.Segment = m.Segment AND pc.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY pc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_customers WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_customers WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_customers WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_customers WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_customers WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest_customers WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
     FROM yearmonth AS T1
     JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Segment = 'LAM'
      AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS SME_minus_LAM,
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
     FROM yearmonth AS T1
     JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Segment = 'LAM'
      AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)

     FROM yearmonth AS T1
     JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Segment = 'KAM'
      AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS LAM_minus_KAM,
  (SELECT SUM(T1.Consumption) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
     FROM yearmonth AS T1
     JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Segment = 'KAM'
      AND T1.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312)
  -

     FROM yearmonth AS T1
     JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
    WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Segment = 'SME'

       SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item,
       c.Currency
FROM customers c

LIMIT 1;

WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'

      SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
      FROM Player_Attributes

            SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
            FROM Player_Attributes
            WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'

  );

WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'

      SELECT AVG(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2

FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'

FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district) AS salary_gap
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district)
  AND c.birth_date = (
        SELECT MAX(c2.birth_date)
        FROM client c2
        JOIN district d2 ON d2.district_id = c2.district_id
        WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
          AND d2.A11 = (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district)
  );

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
      / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997')
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM disp d
        JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
        WHERE d.account_id = l.account_id
          AND c.gender = 'M'
      );

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom1_id, a1.element AS atom1_element,
       a2.atom_id AS atom2_id, a2.element AS atom2_element
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage

    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2

SELECT c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption

LIMIT 1;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, t.total_consumption
    FROM totals AS t
    JOIN min_totals AS m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg_consumption
    FROM lowest_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
minTotals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annualAvg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.TotalConsumption) / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS AnnualAvgConsumption
    FROM totals t
    JOIN minTotals m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.TotalConsumption = m.MinConsumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM annualAvg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM annualAvg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM annualAvg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM annualAvg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS Diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM annualAvg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvgConsumption FROM annualAvg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS Diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT 
    u.Id AS UserId,
    u.DisplayName,
    b.Name AS Badge,
    cnt.CommentCount
FROM (
    -- Find users whose comment count equals the maximum comment count
    SELECT UserId, COUNT(Id) AS CommentCount
    FROM comments
    GROUP BY UserId
    HAVING COUNT(Id) = (
        SELECT MAX(CommentCount)
        FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(Id) AS CommentCount
            FROM comments
            GROUP BY UserId
        ) AS counts
    )
) AS cnt
JOIN users u 
    ON cnt.UserId = u.Id
LEFT JOIN badges b 
    ON b.UserId = u.Id
ORDER BY cnt.CommentCount DESC, u.Id, b.Name;

WITH customer_consumption AS (          -- annual (2013) consumption per customer
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        c.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y
      ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (                    -- lowest consumption in each segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_average AS (                    -- annual average = total / count of lowest consumers
    SELECT cc.Segment,
           SUM(cc.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON cc.Segment = m.Segment
     AND cc.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'SME')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_average WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT

          / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS pct_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp d     ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN account a  ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district dt ON dt.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE dt.A11 > 10000;

WITH male_loans AS (
    -- Loans tied to accounts where at least one owner/disponent is male
    SELECT DISTINCT l.loan_id, l.date, l.amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN disp d   ON d.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id  = d.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', date) = '1996' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_1996,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', date) = '1997' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_1997
    FROM male_loans
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) IN ('1996', '1997')
)
SELECT
    (total_1997 - total_1996) * 100.0 / total_1996 AS growth_rate
FROM totals;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'north Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END) -
  SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'east Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END) AS crime_difference
FROM district
WHERE A3 IN ('north Bohemia', 'east Bohemia');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount                          AS loan_amount,
    l.payments                        AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration                        AS duration_months,
    l.status,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Finished - no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Finished - loan NOT paid'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Running - OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Running - client in debt'
    END                               AS status_description,
    COALESCE(p.paid_so_far, 0)        AS amount_paid_so_far,
    l.amount - COALESCE(p.paid_so_far, 0) AS remaining_debt
FROM client c
JOIN disp d  ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l  ON d.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS paid_so_far
    FROM trans
    WHERE k_symbol = 'U'          -- 'U' = loan payment transactions
    GROUP BY account_id
) p ON l.account_id = p.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

SELECT
    /* Which group is larger? */
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) >
             COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END)
            THEN 'in-patient'
        WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) <
             COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END)
            THEN 'outpatient'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS more_common,

    /* Supporting counts */
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS in_patient_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS outpatient_count,

    /* Deviation in percentage = in-patients / outpatients */
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END), 0) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT c.atom_id2
FROM connected c

WITH bond_elements AS (
    -- one row per bond, carrying the elements of its two endpoint atoms
    SELECT
        c.bond_id,
        MIN(a1.element, a2.element) AS elem1,   -- normalize so (C,H) == (H,C)
        MAX(a1.element, a2.element) AS elem2
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
),
pair_counts AS (
    -- how many bonds each element combination has
    SELECT elem1, elem2, COUNT(*) AS bond_cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY elem1, elem2
)
SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 * SUM(bond_cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond),
       2) AS pct_of_bonds
FROM pair_counts
WHERE bond_cnt = (SELECT MAX(bond_cnt) FROM pair_counts);

SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.CustomerID,
           ym.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c
      ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT z.Segment,
           SUM(z.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(z.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON z.Segment = m.Segment
     AND z.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
  AND SUBSTR(T1.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1,  m.home_player_2,  m.home_player_3,  m.home_player_4,
        m.home_player_5,  m.home_player_6,  m.home_player_7,  m.home_player_8,
        m.home_player_9,  m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1,  m.away_player_2,  m.away_player_3,  m.away_player_4,
        m.away_player_5,  m.away_player_6,  m.away_player_7,  m.away_player_8,
        m.away_player_9,  m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, c.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p 
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
JOIN Match m 
    ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1,  m.home_player_2,  m.home_player_3,  m.home_player_4,  m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6,  m.home_player_7,  m.home_player_8,  m.home_player_9,  m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1,  m.away_player_2,  m.away_player_3,  m.away_player_4,  m.away_player_5,
        m.away_player_6,  m.away_player_7,  m.away_player_8,  m.away_player_9,  m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
JOIN Country c 
    ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE pa.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name AS country_name
FROM Country c
JOIN Match m ON m.country_id = c.id
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1,  m.home_player_2,  m.home_player_3,  m.home_player_4,
        m.home_player_5,  m.home_player_6,  m.home_player_7,  m.home_player_8,
        m.home_player_9,  m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1,  m.away_player_2,  m.away_player_3,  m.away_player_4,
        m.away_player_5,  m.away_player_6,  m.away_player_7,  m.away_player_8,
        m.away_player_9,  m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
     )
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA 
    ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

WITH italy_league_ids AS (
    SELECT l.id
    FROM League l
    JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
    WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
),
italy_matches AS (
    SELECT home_player_1, home_player_2, home_player_3, home_player_4, home_player_5,
           home_player_6, home_player_7, home_player_8, home_player_9, home_player_10, home_player_11,
           away_player_1, away_player_2, away_player_3, away_player_4, away_player_5,
           away_player_6, away_player_7, away_player_8, away_player_9, away_player_10, away_player_11
    FROM Match
    WHERE league_id IN (SELECT id FROM italy_league_ids)
),
italy_players AS (
    SELECT home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_2  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_3  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_4  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_5  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_6  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_7  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_8  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_9  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT home_player_11 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_1  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_2  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_3  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_4  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_5  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_6  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_7  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_8  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_9  FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_10 FROM italy_matches
    UNION SELECT away_player_11 FROM italy_matches
)
SELECT AVG(p.height) AS avg_height
FROM Player p
JOIN italy_players ip ON p.player_api_id = ip.player_api_id;

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN strength > 80 AND stamina > 80 THEN player_api_id END) * 100.0
  / COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS percentage_of_players
FROM Player_Attributes;

SELECT COUNT(T1.account_id)
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 
    ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id
INNER JOIN loan AS T3 
    ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id
WHERE T2.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND T3.status = 'C';

SELECT 
    AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
    AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    CASE 
        WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
        ELSE '1996'
    END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

WITH oldest_females AS (
    -- Step 1: female client(s) with the latest birth_date = oldest
    SELECT client_id, district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date)
                        FROM client
                        WHERE gender = 'F')
),
target_clients AS (
    -- Step 2: among the oldest females, keep the one(s)
    -- whose district has the lowest average salary (A11)
    SELECT f.client_id, d.A11
    FROM oldest_females f
    JOIN district d ON f.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
                   FROM oldest_females f2
                   JOIN district d2 ON f2.district_id = d2.district_id)
)
-- Step 3: their account numbers + gap vs. the highest average salary
SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - t.A11 AS salary_gap
FROM target_clients t
JOIN disp dp   ON t.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id;

SELECT a.account_id, l.amount
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND a.date LIKE '93%'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
      FROM loan l2
      WHERE l2.duration > 12
  );

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT a.date AS account_open_date
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 840
  AND t.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS biggest_transaction_amount
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND a.date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31';

SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency,
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    c.birth_date
FROM account a
JOIN disp d
    ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c
    ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district di
    ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND di.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A3 AS district_name
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    d.A3 AS branch_location,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A13 AS unemployment_rate_1996
FROM district d
WHERE d.A13 = (SELECT MAX(A13) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts_opened
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A16 = (SELECT MAX(A16) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS running_contract_accounts
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND a.district_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM district
      ORDER BY A15 DESC
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_gold_owner_cards
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_clients
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha'
  AND client.gender = 'M';

SELECT card.type
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
WHERE client.client_id = 13539;

SELECT district.A3 AS region
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.client_id = 3541;

SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) 
          / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id), 2) AS pct_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp d     ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a  ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1997 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
        -
        SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
    ) * 100.0
    /
    SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', l.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
        AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d    ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c  ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'north Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END)
    -
    SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'east Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END) AS crime_difference
FROM district;

SELECT strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE d.disp_id = 130
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS number_of_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    l.date AS loan_date,
    l.amount AS loan_amount,
    l.duration AS duration_months,
    l.payments AS monthly_payment,
    l.status,
    CASE
        WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN 'Contract finished - no problems'
        WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 'Contract finished - loan NOT paid (debt)'
        WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 'Contract running - payments OK so far'
        WHEN l.status = 'D' THEN 'Contract running - client IN DEBT'
    END AS payment_status
FROM client c
JOIN disp    d ON c.client_id  = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan    l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d   ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
WHERE c.client_id = 617
  AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
  AND t.date <  '1999-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun'
  AND a.date > '1996-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS num_loan_accounts
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration = 24
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM client c
JOIN disp d  ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(m.member_id) AS num_students
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.college = 'College of Engineering';

SELECT COUNT(T1.link_to_member) 
FROM attendance AS T1 
JOIN event AS T2 
    ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id 
WHERE T2.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
ORDER BY COUNT(a.link_to_event) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.event_id) AS num_events
FROM event AS T1
JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
JOIN member AS T3 ON T2.link_to_member = T3.member_id
WHERE T3.first_name = 'Sacha'
  AND T3.last_name = 'Harrison'
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.event_date) = '2019';

SELECT COUNT(e.event_id) AS num_meetings
FROM event AS e
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'
  AND e.event_id IN (
      SELECT a.link_to_event
      FROM attendance AS a
      GROUP BY a.link_to_event
      HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 10
  );

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a
    ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type != 'Fundraiser'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_event) > 20;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(e.event_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_name) AS average_attendance
FROM event AS e
INNER JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'
  AND strftime('%Y', e.event_date) = '2020';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Laugh Out Loud';

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_food_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Food'
  AND e.event_name = 'September Meeting';

SELECT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.position = 'President';

SELECT notes
FROM income
WHERE source = 'Fundraising'
  AND date_received = '2019-09-14';

SELECT m.phone
FROM member m
WHERE m.first_name = 'Carlo'
  AND m.last_name = 'Jacobs';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS exceeded_budget_count
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'November Meeting'
  AND b.remaining < 0;

SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budget_amount
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'September Speaker';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_medium_tshirt_members
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE ma.major_name = 'Business'
  AND m.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

SELECT 
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN income i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member
WHERE i.source = 'Dues'
ORDER BY i.date_received ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.category = 'Parking' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
        / SUM(b.amount),
        2
    ) AS parking_budget_percentage
FROM budget b
JOIN event e
    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'November Speaker';

SELECT 
    z.city,
    z.county,
    z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Amy' 
  AND m.last_name = 'Firth';

SELECT COUNT(m.member_id) AS num_members_from_maryland
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE z.state = 'Maryland';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS meeting_count
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Meeting'
  AND strftime('%Y', event_date) = '2020';

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name
FROM event ev
JOIN budget b  ON ev.event_id = b.link_to_event
JOIN expense e ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
JOIN member m  ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Community Service' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / COUNT(event_id) AS pct_community_service
FROM event
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2019-12-31';

SELECT t_shirt_size
FROM member
GROUP BY t_shirt_size
ORDER BY COUNT(t_shirt_size) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT event.event_name
FROM event
JOIN budget ON event.event_id = budget.link_to_event
WHERE event.status = 'Closed'
  AND budget.remaining < 0
ORDER BY budget.remaining ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    b.category,
    SUM(b.amount) AS amount_budgeted
FROM budget b
JOIN event e 
    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'April Speaker'
GROUP BY b.category
ORDER BY amount_budgeted ASC;

SELECT budget_id, category, MAX(amount) AS highest_amount
FROM budget
WHERE category = 'Food'
GROUP BY budget_id, category;

SELECT T1.major_name
FROM major AS T1
JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major
WHERE T2.first_name = 'Phillip' AND T2.last_name = 'Cullen';

SELECT DISTINCT m.position
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Business';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'Business'
  AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

SELECT major.major_name
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.position = 'Vice President';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_majors
FROM major
WHERE college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences'
  AND department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education';

SELECT DISTINCT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE mj.department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department'
  AND m.position = 'Member';

SELECT m.last_name
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event AS e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE m.position = 'Member'
  AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT event_name
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Game'
  AND status = 'Closed'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20';

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    a.link_to_event
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a 
    ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN expense e 
    ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.approved = 'true'
  AND e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT DISTINCT m.email
FROM member m
JOIN expense e 
    ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19'
  AND e.cost > 20;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS num_members
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Education'
  AND mj.college = 'College of Education & Human Services'
  AND m.position = 'Member';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense e
JOIN member m  ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b  ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev  ON b.link_to_event  = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY MAX(e.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT DISTINCT 
    m.first_name, 
    m.last_name, 
    m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN expense e 
    ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

SELECT major.major_name, major.department
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Garrett'
  AND member.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT 
    m.last_name,
    m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT 
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    mj.college
FROM member m
JOIN major mj 
    ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Secretary';

SELECT event.event_name, SUM(budget.spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE budget.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY event.event_name;

SELECT T2.city
FROM member AS T1
JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code
WHERE T1.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T1.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
GROUP BY T1.full_name
HAVING COUNT(T1.full_name) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(s.id) AS num_superheroes
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT 
    s.superhero_name,
    s.height_cm,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC) AS height_rank
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC;

SELECT COUNT(s.id) AS num_superheroes
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics';

SELECT superhero.superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY hero_attribute.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(s.id), 
        2
    ) AS percentage_bad,
    SUM(
        CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' 
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS marvel_bad_superheroes
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) AS average_weight
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Alien';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND T2.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.colour AS hair_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'Human';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE hp.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute ha2
      JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id
      WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'strength'
  );

SELECT COUNT(id) / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) AS average
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT DISTINCT eye_colour.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero
JOIN colour AS skin_colour 
    ON superhero.skin_colour_id = skin_colour.id
JOIN colour AS eye_colour 
    ON superhero.eye_colour_id = eye_colour.id
WHERE skin_colour.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percent
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky')
    -
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler')
    AS weight_difference;

SELECT SUM(s.height_cm) / COUNT(*) AS average_height
FROM superhero s;

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
  AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT ha.attribute_value AS strength
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS green_skinned_villain_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Green'
  AND a.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes
FROM hero_attribute
JOIN attribute ON attribute.id = hero_attribute.attribute_id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE c.colour = 'brown'
  AND s.weight_kg < 100;

SELECT 
    superhero.weight_kg,
    race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT s.id
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_inpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_outpatient_count,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >
             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        THEN 'More in-patients'
        ELSE 'More outpatients'
    END AS comparison,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
    4) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT 
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1930 AND 1940;

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', Birthday)) - MIN(strftime('%Y', Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT 
    T1.Date, 
    strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'
);

SELECT T2."aCL IgM"
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2."Examination Date" = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT = '9'
  AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Date) AS INTEGER) 
     - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' 
  AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 2
  AND Examination.`ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND Examination.`aCL IgM` > (
        SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2
        FROM Examination
      );

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       / COUNT(SEX) * 100 AS percentage_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT DATEDIFF(MIN(e.`Examination Date`), p.`First Date`) AS `Days Until Evaluation`
FROM `Patient` p
JOIN `Examination` e ON e.`ID` = p.`ID`
WHERE p.`ID` = 821298;

SELECT p.ID,
       l.ALP,
       CASE WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT 
    Laboratory.ID,
    Laboratory.Date,
    Laboratory.TP,
    Laboratory.TP - 8.5 AS TP_deviation
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID,
       p.Birthday,
       l.ALB,
       CASE
           WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
           ELSE 'Outside normal range'
       END AS ALB_Status
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS average_UA
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L 
    ON L.ID = P.ID
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS latest_date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) Latest 
    ON Latest.ID = L.ID 
   AND Latest.latest_date = L.Date
WHERE (P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)
   OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;

SELECT (SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F')) AS Answer
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    P.SEX, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS Patient_IDs
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.`T-CHO`
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.APTT > 45
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (L.FG < 150 OR L.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 
  AND T2.IGG < 2000 
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE Patient.Description IS NULL 
  AND Patient.ID IN (
      SELECT Laboratory.ID 
      FROM Laboratory 
      WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.SM IN ('negative', '0')
  AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E."Examination Date" > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_female_patients_no_symptoms
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(SUBSTR(T1.`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Patient.ID END) * 1.0 / COUNT(Patient.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(T2.Birthday)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`) AS first_recorded_date
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE P.ID = (
    SELECT L.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L.LDH < 500
    ORDER BY L.LDH DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS num_male_patients
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.ALB > 3.5
  AND L.ALB < 5.5
  AND L.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) AS highest_ANA_level
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T2."aCL IgA" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT E.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
ORDER BY L.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) AS num_molecules_with_cl
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
        / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS avg_single_bonded
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b     ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT T1.element, T2.element
FROM connected AS C
JOIN atom AS T1 ON C.atom_id = T1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T2 ON C.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
WHERE C.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id,
       c.atom_id2,
       m.molecule_id
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b
  ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'        -- not carcinogenic
  AND b.bond_type = '-'    -- single bond
ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id, bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id,
       m.label,
       CASE 
           WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
           ELSE 'Not carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT label
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (
    SELECT c.atom_id
    FROM connected c
    UNION
    SELECT c.atom_id2
    FROM connected c
);

SELECT a1.atom_id   AS atom1_id,
       a1.element   AS atom1_element,
       a2.atom_id   AS atom2_id,
       a2.element   AS atom2_element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1      ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2      ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type  = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

WITH bond_elements AS (              -- each bond paired with its two atoms' elements
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           a1.element AS element_1,
           a2.element AS element_2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id  = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id  = c.atom_id2
),
combo_counts AS (                    -- number of bonds per element combination
    SELECT element_1, element_2, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY element_1, element_2
)
SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / SUM(cnt) AS percentage
FROM combo_counts;

SELECT ROUND(
           SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
           / COUNT(bond.bond_id), 
       5) AS carcinogenic_percentage
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS num_elements
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN COUNT(*) >= 1 THEN 'yes' 
         ELSE 'no' 
       END AS has_chlorine_and_carbon
FROM connected AS cn
JOIN atom AS a1 
  ON cn.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 
  ON cn.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE cn.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ( (a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
     OR (a1.element = 'c'  AND a2.element = 'cl') );

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules

WITH match_players AS (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1  AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9  FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
)
