JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id
WHERE T2.major_name = 'Business';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member AS T1 
JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id 
WHERE T2.major_name = 'Business' AND T1.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'
SELECT type FROM event WHERE event_date = '2020-03-24T12:00:00'

SELECT major.major_name 
FROM major 
JOIN member ON major.major_id = member.link_to_major 
WHERE member.position = 'Vice President'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM income WHERE amount = 50;

SELECT COUNT(major_id)
FROM major
WHERE college = 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences'
  AND department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education';

SELECT DISTINCT zip_code.city, zip_code.state
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
JOIN zip_code ON member.zip = zip_code.zip_code
WHERE major.department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department'
  AND member.position = 'Member';

SELECT m.last_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
  AND m.position = 'Member';

SELECT event_name
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Game'
  AND status = 'Closed'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20';

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T3.link_to_event
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
INNER JOIN attendance AS T3 ON T1.member_id = T3.link_to_member
WHERE T2.approved = 'true'
  AND T2.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT DISTINCT member.email
FROM expense
JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE expense.cost > 20
  AND expense.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.major_name = 'education' 
  AND major.college = 'College of Education & Human Services' 
  AND member.position = 'Member';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT SUM(ex.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense AS ex
JOIN member AS m  ON ex.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget AS b  ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event  AS ev ON b.link_to_event   = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
GROUP BY T1.member_id, T1.first_name, T1.last_name
ORDER BY SUM(T2.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT T1.first_name, 
       T1.last_name, 
       T1.phone
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 
        ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

SELECT major.major_name, major.department
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Garrett' AND member.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT member.last_name, member.phone 
FROM member 
INNER JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, ma.college
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Secretary'

SELECT 
    SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent,
    e.event_name
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;

SELECT T2.city 
FROM member AS T1 
JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code 
WHERE T1.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T1.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
GROUP BY T2.hero_id
HAVING COUNT(T1.full_name) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY T1.height_cm DESC;

SELECT COUNT(id) 
FROM superhero 
WHERE publisher_id = (
    SELECT id 
    FROM publisher 
    WHERE publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
)

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / COUNT(s.id) AS percentage_bad,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_bad_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;
SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE full_name IS NULL;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(T1.weight_kg) 
FROM superhero AS T1 
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id 
WHERE T2.gender = 'Female'

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.race = 'Alien';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God';

SELECT colour.colour
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.height_cm = 185
  AND race.race = 'human';

SELECT superpower.power_name
FROM hero_power
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE hero_power.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT T1.height_cm
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.colour = 'Amber'

SELECT DISTINCT T3.colour
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.skin_colour_id = T2.id
JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky') 
     - (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS weight_difference;

SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) AS average_height
FROM superhero;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'Male';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(alignment.id) AS percentage
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
INNER JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE alignment.id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute AS ha
JOIN superhero AS s ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND s.superhero_name = 'Hulk';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM hero_attribute AS ha
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed' 
  AND ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT hero_id
FROM hero_attribute
ORDER BY attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.weight_kg < 100 AND T2.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / 
       COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT T1.ID,
       STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Examination E
JOIN Patient P ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', Birthday)) - MIN(strftime('%Y', Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT 
    T1.Date, 
    STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T1.`aCL IgM`
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GPT = 9 
AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.Date) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T3.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T3.ID = T2.ID 
    AND T3.`Examination Date` = T2.`First Date`
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27' 
    AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(ID)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND P.Admission = '-'

SELECT JULIANDAY(T1.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(T2.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS T2
JOIN Examination AS T1 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT P.ID, L.ALP,
       CASE WHEN L.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_Normal
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT T.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS T ON P.ID = T.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND T.TP > 8.5;

SELECT *
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M'
  AND ID IN (
      SELECT ID
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE ALB <= 3.5 OR ALB >= 5.5
  )
ORDER BY Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    p.ID, 
    p.Birthday, 
    l.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS 'Albumin within normal range'
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(l.UA) AS avg_UA
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS latest_date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) latest 
    ON l.ID = latest.ID AND l.Date = latest.latest_date
JOIN Patient p 
    ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0)
   OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND T2.UN < 30;

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM Patient P
   JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
   WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.CRE >= 1.5)
  >
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM Patient P
   JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
   WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.CRE >= 1.5) AS Answer;

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT P.ID, L."T-CHO"
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS abnormal_fg_patient_count
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (Laboratory.FG < 150 OR Laboratory.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
  AND T2.`U-PRO` > 0 
  AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900
  AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T3.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT t1.ID
FROM Patient AS t1
JOIN Laboratory AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID
WHERE t2.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', t1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN E.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.`First Date`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH < 500
ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.`Examination Date`
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY T2.ALB DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) 
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.ALB > 3.5
  AND L.ALB < 5.5
  AND L.TP >= 6.0
  AND L.TP <= 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T2.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) 
FROM atom 
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(atom_id) FROM connected)
FROM bond
WHERE bond_type = '-' 
  AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+');

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT T1.element, T2.element
FROM connected AS T3
JOIN atom AS T1 ON T3.atom_id = T1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T3.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
WHERE T3.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' 
  AND m.label = '-'
ORDER BY b.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (
    SELECT atom_id FROM connected
    UNION
    SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected
);

SELECT a1.element, a2.element

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Monthly consumption rows of CZK customers in 2013, with their segment
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           y.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest consumption value in each segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average consumption of the customers with the least consumption
    SELECT cz.Segment,
           SUM(cz.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(cz.CustomerID) AS annual_avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 AS cz
    JOIN min_per_segment AS m
      ON m.Segment = cz.Segment
     AND m.min_consumption = cz.Consumption
    GROUP BY cz.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ym.Consumption > 46.73 THEN ym.CustomerID END)
              / COUNT(DISTINCT ym.CustomerID),
        2
    ) AS Percentage
FROM customers AS c
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym 
        ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM';

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
    * 100 / COUNT(CustomerID) AS percentage
FROM customers
WHERE Segment = 'KAM';

SELECT MAX(monthly_consumption) AS biggest_monthly_consumption
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) / 12 AS monthly_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c 
        ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
) AS sub;

SELECT DISTINCT P.Description
FROM yearmonth Y
JOIN transactions_1k T ON Y.CustomerID = T.CustomerID
JOIN products P ON T.ProductID = P.ProductID
WHERE Y.Date = 201309;

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country
FROM gasstations AS g
JOIN transactions_1k AS t 
    ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
JOIN yearmonth AS y 
    ON t.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date = '201306';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS num_customers
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  AND y.Consumption > 1000;

SELECT CustomerID
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
GROUP BY CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(Amount * Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
ORDER BY t.Time ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Segment
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
ORDER BY t.Date ASC, t.Time ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Country 
FROM transactions_1k AS T1 
JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID 
WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Time = '12:42:00'

SELECT T2.Currency
FROM yearmonth AS T1
JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Date = '201306' AND T1.Consumption = 214582.17

SELECT T2.Country
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Price = 548.4;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) * 100.0
    / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS percentage
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN customers AS c 
    ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';

SELECT SUM(Price) AS TotalSpent
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE CustomerID = 38508
  AND Date = '201201';

SELECT 
    t.CustomerID,
    c.Currency,
    SUM(t.Price) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c 
    ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY 
    t.CustomerID, 
    c.Currency
ORDER BY 
    SUM(t.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes
ORDER BY potential ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
GROUP BY player_api_id
ORDER BY MAX(crossing) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    T.team_long_name,
    COUNT(M.id) AS losses
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T 
    ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
  AND (M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal) < 0
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY losses ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating = (
        SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
        FROM Player_Attributes
        WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
          AND overall_rating > (
                SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
                FROM Player_Attributes
                WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
          )
  );

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T2.team_long_name)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      JOIN Team AS T2 ON T2.team_api_id = TA2.team_api_id
      WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
        AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT SUM(PA.long_shots) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) AS avg_long_shots
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.height > 180
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(PA.heading_accuracy) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    T.team_long_name
FROM 
    Team AS T
    JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA 
        ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE 
    TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
    AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND TA.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
    AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
        SELECT AVG(TA2.chanceCreationPassing)
        FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
        WHERE TA2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
          AND TA2.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
          AND TA2.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
    )
ORDER BY 
    TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

SELECT PA.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro';

SELECT T2.heading_accuracy
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Francois Affolter'
  AND T2.date = '2014-09-18 00:00:00';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match 
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id 
WHERE League.name = 'Scotland Premier League' 
  AND Match.season = '2015/2016';

SELECT DISTINCT pa.preferred_foot
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.birthday = (SELECT MAX(birthday) FROM Player);

SELECT L.name
FROM League AS L
JOIN Country AS C ON L.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Netherlands';

SELECT SUM(Match.home_team_goal) / COUNT(DISTINCT Match.id) AS average_home_team_goal
FROM Match
JOIN Country ON Match.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Country.name = 'Poland'
  AND Match.season = '2010/2011';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating > 80
  AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) BETWEEN '2008' AND '2010';

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa 
    ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT TA.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_short_name = 'CLB';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayPassing > 70;

SELECT Country.name
FROM League
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id
WHERE League.name = 'Italy Serie A';

SELECT COUNT(Match.id) AS match_count
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE League.name = 'Germany 1. Bundesliga'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', Match.date) BETWEEN '2008-08' AND '2008-10';

SELECT P.player_name, PA.overall_rating
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA 
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone')
GROUP BY P.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(PA.crossing) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(Match.id) AS num_matches
FROM Match
JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id
WHERE League.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
  AND SUBSTR(Match.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04';

SELECT L.name AS league_name
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(Player_Attributes.overall_rating) / COUNT(Player_Attributes.id) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', Player.birthday) < '1986';

SELECT T2.preferred_foot
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo';

SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) 
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 
INNER JOIN Player AS T2 
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id 
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon';

SELECT T2.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 
    ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.overall_rating = 77
  AND T1.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY T2.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND T2.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';

SELECT T2.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud'
  AND T2.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00';

SELECT AVG(T2.overall_rating)
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
  AND SUBSTR(T2.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21';

SELECT T.player_name
FROM (
    SELECT player_name, 
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height DESC) AS rank_height
    FROM Player
) AS T
WHERE T.rank_height = 1;

SELECT DISTINCT Player.player_name
FROM Player
JOIN Match ON Player.player_api_id IN (
    Match.home_player_1, Match.home_player_2, Match.home_player_3, Match.home_player_4,
    Match.home_player_5, Match.home_player_6, Match.home_player_7, Match.home_player_8,
    Match.home_player_9, Match.home_player_10, Match.home_player_11,
    Match.away_player_1, Match.away_player_2, Match.away_player_3, Match.away_player_4,
    Match.away_player_5, Match.away_player_6, Match.away_player_7, Match.away_player_8,
    Match.away_player_9, Match.away_player_10, Match.away_player_11
)
JOIN Country ON Match.country_id = Country.id
WHERE Country.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.player_name,
    c.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
JOIN Match m
    ON pa.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1,  m.home_player_2,  m.home_player_3,  m.home_player_4,  m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6,  m.home_player_7,  m.home_player_8,  m.home_player_9,  m.home_player_10,
        m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1,  m.away_player_2,  m.away_player_3,  m.away_player_4,
        m.away_player_5,  m.away_player_6,  m.away_player_7,  m.away_player_8,  m.away_player_9,
        m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
JOIN Country c
    ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE pa.vision > 89;

SELECT C.name AS country_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Match AS M
    ON P.player_api_id IN (
        M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5,
        M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11,
        M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5,
        M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11
    )
JOIN Country AS C
    ON M.country_id = C.id
GROUP BY C.name
ORDER BY AVG(P.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow'

SELECT AVG(DISTINCT P.height) AS avg_height
FROM Player AS P
WHERE P.player_api_id IN (
    SELECT u.player_api_id
    FROM (
        SELECT home_player_1  AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT home_player_2  AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT home_player_3  AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT home_player_4  AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT home_player_5  AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT home_player_6  AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT home_player_7  AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT home_player_8  AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT home_player_9  AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT home_player_10 AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT home_player_11 AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT away_player_1  AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT away_player_2  AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT away_player_3  AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT away_player_4  AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT away_player_5  AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT away_player_6  AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT away_player_7  AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT away_player_8  AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT away_player_9  AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT away_player_10 AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match UNION ALL
        SELECT away_player_11 AS player_api_id, country_id FROM Match
    ) AS u
    JOIN Country AS C ON C.id = u.country_id
    WHERE C.name = 'Italy'
      AND u.player_api_id IS NOT NULL
);

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE height > 180
ORDER BY player_name
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l     ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT 
    acc.account_id,
    (SELECT MAX(d2.A11) - MIN(d2.A11) 
     FROM district d2) AS salary_gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dsp    ON dsp.client_id   = c.client_id
JOIN account acc ON acc.account_id  = dsp.account_id
JOIN district d  ON d.district_id   = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(c2.birth_date) 
                      FROM client c2 
                      WHERE c2.gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(d3.A11) 
               FROM district d3);

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT t.account_id
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND t.balance > 3000;

SELECT account.date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS biggest_transaction
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card AS c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', account.date) AS INTEGER) = 1996;

SELECT DISTINCT 
    a.account_id, 
    a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d 
    ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c 
    ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dt 
    ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', a.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1995 AND 2000;

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A3 AS district_name
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l    ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')          -- 'C' = running contract OK, 'D' = running contract in debt
GROUP BY d.A3
ORDER BY SUM(l.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts_opened
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A16 = (SELECT MAX(A16) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan
INNER JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE account.district_id = 1
  AND loan.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
WHERE gender = 'M' 
  AND district_id = (
      SELECT district_id 
      FROM district 
      ORDER BY A15 DESC 
      LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_gold_owner_cards
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM "order" o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.account_id)
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
JOIN trans ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND trans.bank = 'AB';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_male_clients
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha'
  AND client.gender = 'M';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent_gold_before_1998
FROM card;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE disp.client_id = 13539;

SELECT district.A3
FROM client
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.client_id = 3541;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_women
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
    WHERE di.A11 > 10000
) t;

SELECT
    ( SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
    ) * 100.0
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS growth_rate
FROM loan AS l
JOIN disp   AS d ON d.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id  = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount AS debt_amount,
    l.status,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Contract finished - no problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Contract finished - loan NOT paid'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Running contract - OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Running contract - client in debt'
    END AS payment_status,
    l.payments AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration AS duration_months
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 617
  AND t.type = 'withdrawal'
  AND t.date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Beroun'
  AND a.date > '1996-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(l.account_id) AS loan_account_count
FROM loan AS l
JOIN account AS a
    ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration = 24
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.status = 'C';

SELECT
    T1.client_id,
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T1.birth_date)) AS age
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN card AS T3 ON T2.disp_id = T3.disp_id
WHERE T3.type = 'gold'
  AND T2.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_students
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.college = 'College of Engineering';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_attendees
FROM attendance
JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT member.phone
FROM member
JOIN attendance ON member.member_id = attendance.link_to_member
JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE event.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
ORDER BY COUNT(a.link_to_member) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(e.event_id) AS num_events_attended
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha'

WITH bond_elem AS (
    -- Element pair for every bond (single pass over connected)
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           a1.element AS elem1,
           a2.element AS elem2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
),
combo_counts AS (
    -- Number of bonds per element combination
    SELECT elem1, elem2, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM bond_elem
    GROUP BY elem1, elem2
)
SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM combo_counts;

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT pc.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(pc.total) AS sum_total,
           COUNT(pc.CustomerID) AS cnt
    FROM per_customer pc
    JOIN min_totals mt ON pc.Segment = mt.Segment AND pc.total = mt.min_total
    GROUP BY pc.Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, CAST(sum_total AS REAL) / cnt AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND substr(CAST(y.Date AS TEXT), 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT p.Segment, SUM(p.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM per_customer p
    JOIN min_seg m ON p.Segment = m.Segment AND p.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)
FROM (
  SELECT c.bond_id, a1.element AS e1, a2.element AS e2
  FROM connected c
  JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
) t
WHERE t.e1 || ',' || t.e2 = (
  SELECT e1 || ',' || e2
  FROM (
    SELECT a1.element AS e1, a2.element AS e2, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
)

SELECT s.full_name FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God' LIMIT 5

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185 AND r.race = 'Human';
SELECT sp.power_name FROM superpower AS sp JOIN hero_power AS hp ON sp.id = hp.power_id WHERE hp.hero_id = 1;
SELECT s.full_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength' ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(COUNT(superhero.id) AS REAL) / SUM(superhero.skin_colour_id = 1) FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT superhero.height_cm FROM superhero INNER JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT DISTINCT c2.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';
SELECT s.full_name FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percent FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
SELECT (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky') - (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler');
SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(id) FROM superhero;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = 1;
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE weight_kg = 0 OR weight_kg IS NULL;
SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';
SELECT p.publisher_name FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, p.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower p ON p.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';
SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80

SELECT race.race FROM superhero JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND LOWER(gender.gender) = 'male';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN superhero.gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;
SELECT ha.attribute_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';
SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE r.race <> 'Human' AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_attribute JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute WHERE attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien';
SELECT s.full_name FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.weight_kg < 100 AND lower(c.colour) = 'brown'
SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE s.id = 40
SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_power WHERE power_id = (SELECT id FROM superpower WHERE power_name = 'Intelligence');

SELECT DISTINCT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_more, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M'
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940';
SELECT P.ID, CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Patient P JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID WHERE E.RVVT = '+';
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5

SELECT MAX(CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.TG >= 200

SELECT T2.`Date`, SUBSTR(T1.`First Date`, 1, 4) - SUBSTR(T1.Birthday, 1, 4) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID;
SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30')
SELECT T2.`aCL IgM` FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19' AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'
SELECT P.SEX FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.GPT = '9' AND L.Date = '1992-06-12'

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.UA = '8.4' AND l.Date = '1991-10-21';
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2."Examination Date" = '1997-01-27' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+' ORDER BY ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2 AND T2.ANA = 'S' AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS' AND T3.CRP > 2 AND T3.CRE = 1 AND T3.LDH = 123
SELECT MAX(Symptoms) FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473
SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'RA' AND Birthday LIKE '1980%'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET''S DISEASE' AND T1.Admission = '-'
SELECT JULIANDAY("Examination Date") - JULIANDAY("First Date") FROM Patient JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500
SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300 FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', T1.Birthday) = '1982-04-01'
SELECT Laboratory.TP - 8.5 FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5
SELECT DISTINCT T1.* FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC

SELECT P.ID, CASE WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALB_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(l.UA)
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.Date = (SELECT MAX(l2.Date) FROM Laboratory l2 WHERE l2.ID = l.ID)
  AND ((p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND l.UN < 30;
SELECT SUM(P.SEX = 'M') > SUM(P.SEX = 'F') FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.CRE >= 1.5
SELECT Patient.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory."T-BIL" >= 2.0 GROUP BY Patient.SEX
SELECT T1.ID, T1."T-CHO" FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID ORDER BY T1."T-CHO" DESC, T2.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (l.FG < 150 OR l.FG > 450);
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."U-PRO" > 0 AND l."U-PRO" < 30
  AND p.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE CAST(IGG AS REAL) >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T1.KCT = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RF < 20 AND (CAST(STRFTIME('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 'APS' AND T3.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative','0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') AND T1.SEX = 'F' AND T3.Symptoms IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-', '+-') AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE') AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory WHERE GOT >= 60) * 1.0;
SELECT Birthday FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE GOT >= 60) ORDER BY Birthday DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH < 500 AND T2.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500)
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
SELECT T1.ID FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5 AND T1."aCL IgA" = (SELECT MAX("aCL IgA") FROM Examination)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID WHERE L."T-BIL" >= 2.0 AND E."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%';
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T2.atom_id) FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.label = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') FROM molecule;
SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;
SELECT bond_type FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_type LIMIT 2
SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2 FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

SELECT m.molecule_id, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id;
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected) AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND T2.bond_type = '#'

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a2.atom_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a1.element = 'pb' AND a2.atom_id != a1.atom_id;

SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected AS c JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id GROUP BY MIN(a1.element, a2.element), MAX(a1.element, a2.element) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(molecule.label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id), 5) AS percentage
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) FROM atom a JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' OR molecule_id = 'TR001' OR molecule_id = 'TR002'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.element) = 2 FROM atom AS T1 WHERE T1.element IN ('cl', 'c') AND T1.atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' UNION SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_8')
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-'
SELECT T1.bond_id, CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#'
SELECT count(atom.element) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
SELECT T2.label FROM molecule AS T2 INNER JOIN atom AS T1 ON T2.molecule_id = T1.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'ca'
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(bond_type = ' = ') / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+';
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' AND bond_type = ' = ') AS double_bond_count, (SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006') AS carcinogenic;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');
SELECT m.label FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '+';
SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'c' AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '-');
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'
SELECT a1.molecule_id FROM atom AS a1 JOIN connected AS c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id JOIN bond AS T4 ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id WHERE T2.element = 's' AND T4.bond_type = ' = ';
SELECT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(atom.atom_id) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) FROM molecule JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '#' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT s."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / s."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS rate
FROM frpm s
JOIN schools sch ON s.CDSCode = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sch.SOCType LIKE '%Continuation%'
ORDER BY rate ASC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.sname FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE "Enrollment (K-12)" + "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 500

SELECT s.dname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.dname
ORDER BY AVG(s.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.cds) FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Merged' AND T2.County = 'Alameda' AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT s.CharterNum, AVG(sa.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_writing_score
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sa.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.CharterNum
ORDER BY avg_writing_score DESC;

SELECT schools.School, schools.FundingType FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.County = 'Riverside' GROUP BY schools.School HAVING AVG(satscores.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Monterey'
  AND T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND T2.SOCType = 'High Schools'

SELECT s.School, s.DOC
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > (
    SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
    FROM frpm f2
    JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode

WITH per_customer AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
  GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
  FROM per_customer
  GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_low AS (
  SELECT p.Segment AS Segment, SUM(p.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
  FROM per_customer p
  JOIN mins m ON m.Segment = p.Segment AND m.min_total = p.total
  GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_low WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_low WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_low WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_low WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_low WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_low WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH combos AS (
  SELECT a1.element AS e1, a2.element AS e2, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM connected c
  JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
  GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
),
top AS (
  SELECT e1, e2, cnt FROM combos ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 100.0 * top.cnt / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)
FROM top;

WITH annual AS (
  SELECT ym.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_c
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
  GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mins AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total_c) AS min_c
  FROM annual
  GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
  SELECT a.Segment, SUM(a.total_c) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_c
  FROM annual a
  JOIN mins m ON a.Segment = m.Segment AND a.total_c = m.min_c
  GROUP BY a.Segment
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_c END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_c END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_c END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_c END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_c END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_c END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM lowest;

SELECT c.name
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.country_id, p.player_api_id, p.weight
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Match m
      ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
                             m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10,
                             m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
                             m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9,
                             m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
) t

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(t.cnt) / SUM(t.cnt)
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY CASE
                WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a1.element || a2.element
                ELSE a2.element || a1.element
             END
) t;

WITH czk_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_totals t
    JOIN segment_min m ON m.Segment = t.Segment AND m.min_consumption = t.total_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME
