SELECT T1.full_name FROM superhero AS T1 JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id WHERE T2.race = 'Demi-God' LIMIT 5

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE r.race = 'Human' AND s.height_cm = 185;

SELECT T2.power_name
FROM hero_power AS T1
INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.hero_id = 1

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(id) / SUM(skin_colour_id = 1) FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT T1.height_cm FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Amber'

SELECT T3.colour
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.skin_colour_id = T2.id
JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
SELECT (SELECT SUM(superhero.weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE superhero.full_name = 'Emil Blonsky') - (SELECT SUM(superhero.weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE superhero.full_name = 'Charles Chandler');
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = 1
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE weight_kg = 0 OR weight_kg IS NULL
SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan'

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';
SELECT DISTINCT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
  AND gender.gender = 'male';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN s.gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM superhero s WHERE s.alignment_id = 2
SELECT ha.attribute_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm)
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_attribute JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute ORDER BY attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien'
SELECT s.full_name FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.weight_kg < 100 AND c.colour = 'brown'
SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race FROM superhero JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id WHERE superhero.id = 40
SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE LOWER(a.alignment) = 'neutral';
SELECT hp.hero_id FROM hero_power AS hp JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS more_inpatient,
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31'
SELECT T1.ID, CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RVVT = '+'
SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5
SELECT MAX(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) - MIN(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG >= 200)
SELECT T2.Date, (strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS' ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN p.ID END) * 1.0 /
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN p.ID END) AS ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;
SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', T2.Date) BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'
SELECT T2.`aCL IgM` FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19' AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'
SELECT P.SEX FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.GPT = '9' AND L.Date = '1992-06-12'
SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.Date) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'

SELECT T1."Diagnosis" FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1."Examination Date" = T2."First Date" AND T1.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination WHERE "Diagnosis" = 'SLE' AND "Examination Date" = '1997-01-27')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+'
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Examination WHERE Thrombosis = 2 AND ANA = 'S' AND `aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.Diagnosis = 'PSS' AND T2.CRP > 2 AND T2.CRE = 1 AND T2.LDH = 123
SELECT Symptoms FROM Examination WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE') GROUP BY Symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473
SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' AND T1.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET' AND T1.Admission = '-'
SELECT julianday("Examination Date") - julianday("First Date") FROM Examination JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Patient.ID = 821298
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500
SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300 FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01'
SELECT T1.ID, T2.TP - 8.5 FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.TP > 8.5

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;
SELECT p.ID, CASE WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Albumin within normal range" FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T.UA)
FROM (
    SELECT ID, UA, Date
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Date = (SELECT MAX(Date) FROM Laboratory AS L2 WHERE L2.ID = Laboratory.ID)
) AS T
JOIN Patient ON Patient.ID = T.ID
WHERE (Patient.SEX = 'M' AND T.UA < 8.0)
   OR (Patient.SEX = 'F' AND T.UA < 6.5);
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND T2.UN < 30
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;
SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0 GROUP BY p.SEX

SELECT L.ID, L."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
ORDER BY L."T-CHO" DESC, P."Birthday" ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450)
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE "U-PRO" >= 30);
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2."U-PRO" > 0 AND T2."U-PRO" < 30 AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+' AND Patient.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination e JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE l.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND e.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20 AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2 AND T3.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T1.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') AND T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.Symptoms IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-','+-') AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient."First Date") AS INTEGER) < 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.DNA < 8 AND P.Description IS NULL
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60
SELECT MAX(T2.Birthday) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.GOT >= 60

SELECT MIN(P."First Date")
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
  AND L.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500);
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 WHERE T1.ID IN (SELECT T2.ID FROM Laboratory AS T2 WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5)
SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5 AND T3."aCL IgA" = (SELECT MAX("aCL IgA") FROM Examination)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1."T-BIL" >= 2.0 AND T2."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%'
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(connected.atom_id)
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(atom_id) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=')

SELECT a1.element, a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T3.label = '-'
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element LIMIT 3
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM molecule
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;
SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_type ASC LIMIT 2
SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'
SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR001_10'
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected UNION SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'pb')
UNION
SELECT atom_id FROM connected WHERE atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'pb')

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY MIN(a1.element, a2.element), MAX(a1.element, a2.element)
) t
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';
SELECT molecule_id, label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002')

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS result
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c') OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'))
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT b.bond_id, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';
SELECT atom.element, COUNT(atom.element) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' GROUP BY atom.element;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.label FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.element = 'ca'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';
SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+'
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'c' AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '-')

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id), m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR006' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id) FROM connected AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(*) 
FROM atom a 
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id 
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id 
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR346' 
GROUP BY a.atom_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ')
SELECT m.label FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T4 ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id
WHERE T2.element = 's' AND T4.bond_type = ' = '
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM molecule AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '+' GROUP BY T1.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(T2.atom_id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ' AND a.element = 'o'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-'

SELECT CAST(frpm."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" AS REAL) / frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.EILName = 'Continuation High School'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3
SELECT satscores.sname FROM satscores INNER JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE satscores.NumTstTakr > 500 AND schools.Magnet = 1

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY satscores.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT frpm.CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" + frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 500

SELECT satscores.dname FROM satscores INNER JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Active' GROUP BY satscores.dname ORDER BY AVG(satscores.AvgScrRead) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T2.cds) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.County = 'Alameda' AND T1.StatusType = 'Merged' AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT schools.CharterNum, satscores.sname, satscores.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND schools.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT schools.School, schools.FundingType
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE schools.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY schools.CDSCode, schools.School, schools.FundingType
HAVING AVG(satscores.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT schools.School, schools.Street, schools.City, schools.Zip, schools.State
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE frpm."County Name" = 'Monterey'

WITH czk_consumption AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           y.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM czk_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment AS Segment, t.total_consumption AS total_consumption
    FROM czk_consumption AS t
    JOIN min_consumption AS m
      ON m.Segment = t.Segment AND m.min_total = t.total_consumption
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS SME_LAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS LAM_KAM,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS KAM_SME
FROM annual_avg

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND CAST(y.Date AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_tot AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment AS Segment, AVG(t.total_consumption) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN min_tot m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM'),
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM'),
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME');

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalCons
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
mincons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalCons) AS MinCons
    FROM czk
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT czk.Segment, SUM(czk.TotalCons) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM czk
    JOIN mincons m ON czk.Segment = m.Segment AND czk.TotalCons = m.MinCons
    GROUP BY czk.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS Diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS Diff_KAM_SME;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
averages AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_average
    FROM totals t
    JOIN min_totals m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT annual_average FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(CAST(y.Consumption AS REAL)) AS total
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND CAST(y.Date AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) AS sum_low, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, sum_low / cnt AS avg_low
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_low FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_low FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_low FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_low FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_low FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_low FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_totals AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avgs AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN min_totals mt
      ON ct.Segment = mt.Segment
     AND ct.total_consumption = mt.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT CAST(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS REAL) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'

JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID;

SELECT SUM(Amount * Price) AS TotalSpent,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Date = '201201' THEN Amount * Price ELSE 0 END) AS Jan2012Spent
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE CustomerID = 38508;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           SUM(Price) AS total_price,
           SUM(Amount) AS total_amount,
           SUM(Price) AS total_spend
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
top_customer AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, total_price, total_amount
    FROM totals
    ORDER BY total_spend DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT tc.CustomerID,
       tc.total_price * 1.0 / tc.total_amount AS avg_price_per_item,
       c.Currency
FROM top_customer tc
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = tc.CustomerID;

    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match

WITH client_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = 992
),
loans AS (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        account_id,
        amount,
        payments,
        status,
        (1900 + CAST(substr(date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)) * 12
            + CAST(substr(date, 3, 2) AS INTEGER) AS start_month
    FROM loan
    WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM client_accounts)
),
ref AS (
    SELECT MAX(
               (1900 + CAST(substr(date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)) * 12
                   + CAST(substr(date, 3, 2) AS INTEGER)
           ) AS max_month
    FROM trans
),
actual AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid,
        COUNT(*) AS repayment_count
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.k_symbol = 'UVER'
      AND t.type = 'PRIJEM'
      AND t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM client_accounts)
    GROUP BY t.account_id
)
SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount AS loan_amount,
    l.payments AS scheduled_monthly_payment,
    MAX(l.amount - l.payments * MAX(r.max_month - l.start_month, 0), 0) AS estimated_outstanding_debt,
    l.status AS status_code,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'finished - paid without problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'finished - loan not paid, debt remains'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'running - payments OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'running - client in debt / arrears'
    END AS payment_standing,
    COALESCE(a.total_paid, 0) AS total_paid_via_transactions,
    COALESCE(a.repayment_count, 0) AS repayment_transactions_count
FROM loans l
CROSS JOIN ref r
LEFT JOIN actual a ON a.account_id = l.account_id;

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
  GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM totals
  GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
  SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
  FROM totals t
  JOIN segment_min s ON t.Segment = s.Segment AND t.total_consumption = s.min_consumption
  GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

avg_cons AS (
    SELECT cz.Segment,
           SUM(cz.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk cz
    JOIN min_cons m
      ON cz.Segment = m.Segment AND cz.Consumption = m.min_c
    GROUP BY cz.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID

),

    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS minTotal
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.minTotal
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
        (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
        (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
        (SELECT avg_consumption FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, y.Consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT z.Segment, SUM(z.Consumption) AS total_consumption, COUNT(DISTINCT z.CustomerID) AS num_customers
    FROM czk z
    JOIN seg_min m ON z.Segment = m.Segment AND z.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, total_consumption * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH match_players AS (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
)
SELECT C.name
FROM Country C
JOIN match_players mp ON C.id = mp.country_id
JOIN Player P ON P.player_api_id = mp.player_api_id
GROUP BY C.name
ORDER BY AVG(P.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1

    JOIN atom a4 ON a4.atom_id = c2.atom_id2

    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

)

WITH cust_total AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_total
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(ct.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_total ct
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON ct.Segment = m.Segment AND ct.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_per_segment WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff;

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_per_segment AS (
    SELECT pc.Segment,
           SUM(pc.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(pc.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM per_customer pc
    JOIN min_per_segment ms
      ON pc.Segment = ms.Segment
     AND pc.total_consumption = ms.min_consumption
    GROUP BY pc.Segment
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM avg_per_segment;

JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
  AND district.A11 > 6000
  AND district.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - d.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC, d.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
      FROM loan l2
      JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id
      WHERE l2.duration > 12
        AND STRFTIME('%Y', a2.date) = '1993'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
GROUP BY a.account_id
HAVING MAX(t.balance) > 3000;

SELECT account.date
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE trans.amount = 840
  AND trans.date = '1998-10-14'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS max_transaction_amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice' 
  AND strftime('%Y', account.date) = '1996';

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON dt.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND dt.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND SUBSTR(a.date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1995' AND '2000'
ORDER BY a.account_id;

SELECT account.account_id, account.date
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice'
ORDER BY account.account_id;

SELECT d.A3
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE CAST(REPLACE(d.A16, ',', '') AS REAL) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(REPLACE(A16, ',', '') AS REAL))
    FROM district
);

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS approved_loans
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
  AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND l.status IN ('A', 'C');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND account.district_id = 1;

SELECT COUNT(client_id)
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'M'
  AND district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A15 IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY CAST(A15 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM card 
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id 
WHERE card.type = 'gold' 
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT o.account_id
FROM `order` o
JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek'

SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE LOWER(card.type) = 'gold';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT trans.account_id)
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND trans.bank = 'AB';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT client.client_id)
FROM client
INNER JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha'
  AND client.gender = 'M';

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE
             WHEN LOWER(type) = 'gold'
                  AND (CASE
                         WHEN SUBSTR(issued, 5, 1) = '-'
                           THEN CAST(SUBSTR(issued, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
                         ELSE 1900 + CAST(SUBSTR(issued, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
                       END) < 1998
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0
  / COUNT(*) AS percent_gold_before_1998
FROM card;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.client_id = 13539;
SELECT district.A3 FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.client_id = 3541

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage_female
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE di.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(l.date) = 1997 THEN l.amount END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(l.date) = 1996 THEN l.amount END)) * 100.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(l.date) = 1996 THEN l.amount END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND YEAR(l.date) IN (1996, 1997);

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'north Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'east Bohemia' THEN A16 ELSE 0 END) AS crime_difference
FROM district
WHERE A3 IN ('east Bohemia', 'north Bohemia');

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS birth_year
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE d.account_id = 130
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT disp.account_id)
FROM disp
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT l.amount AS debt_amount,
       l.payments AS monthly_payment,
       l.duration,
       l.status
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992
  AND l.status IN ('B', 'D');

SELECT SUM(T2.amount) 
FROM disp AS T1 
JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id 
WHERE T1.client_id = 617 
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.date) = '1998'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A2 = 'Beroun' 
  AND account.date > '1996-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM loan 
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id 
WHERE loan.duration = 24 
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.client_id, CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(T1.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN card AS T3 ON T2.disp_id = T3.disp_id
WHERE T3.type = 'gold' AND T2.type = 'OWNER';

FROM event

FROM attendance a
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id

FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member

FROM (
    SELECT e.event_id
    FROM event e
    JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'
    GROUP BY e.event_id

) AS meeting_events;

SELECT event.event_name
FROM event
JOIN attendance ON event.event_id = attendance.link_to_event
WHERE LOWER(event.type) != 'fundraiser'
GROUP BY event.event_id, event.event_name
HAVING COUNT(attendance.link_to_member) > 20;

FROM event
INNER JOIN attendance ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id

FROM member
INNER JOIN attendance ON member.member_id = attendance.link_to_member

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member.member_id) AS num_members
FROM member

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM event e

JOIN expense x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id

FROM expense

SELECT COUNT(member.member_id) AS num_members
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.major_name = 'Education'
  AND major.college = 'College of Education & Human Services'
  AND member.position = 'Member';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id)
FROM expense AS e
JOIN member AS m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget AS b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event AS ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id

FROM member

SELECT major.major_name, major.department

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone

SELECT member.first_name, member.last_name, major.college

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

WITH cust_cons AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_cons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM cust_cons
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_cons AS (
    SELECT cc.Segment, SUM(cc.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_total
    FROM cust_cons cc
    JOIN min_cons m ON cc.Segment = m.Segment AND cc.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY cc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_total FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_total FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_total FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_total FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_total FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_total FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT p.Segment, SUM(p.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(p.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM per_customer p
    JOIN min_seg m ON m.Segment = p.Segment AND p.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY p.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.gender_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM superhero s WHERE s.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm)
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_attribute ha JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND ha.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute ORDER BY attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100 AND c.colour = 'brown';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M';
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31'

SELECT P.ID, YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(P.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG >= 200;

SELECT L.`Date`, YEAR(P.`First Date`) - YEAR(P.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND CAST(l.UA AS REAL) <= 8.0 THEN p.ID END) AS REAL) /
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND CAST(l.UA AS REAL) <= 6.5 THEN p.ID END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;
SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'

SELECT T2."aCL IgM"
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2."Examination Date" = '1993-11-12';

SELECT p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GPT = '9' AND l.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT SUBSTR(l.Date, 1, 4) - SUBSTR(p.Birthday, 1, 4) AS age
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.UA = '8.4' AND l.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND e.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
LIMIT 1;
SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND YEAR(Birthday) = 1964 AND Admission = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID)
FROM Examination AS E
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2
  AND E.ANA = 'S'
  AND E.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT DISTINCT p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND l.CRP > 2
  AND l.CRE = 1
  AND l.LDH = 123;
SELECT Symptoms FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' GROUP BY Symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473;
SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) FROM Patient WHERE YEAR(Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND e.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND p.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND p.Admission = '-';
SELECT DATEDIFF(MIN(e.`Examination Date`), p.`First Date`) FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE p.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300 AS "ALP within normal range"
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT L.ID, L.Date, L.TP, L.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, l.Date, l.ALB,
       CASE WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALB_Normal
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(L.UA)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.Date = (SELECT MAX(L2.Date) FROM Laboratory L2 WHERE L2.ID = P.ID)
  AND ((P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0) OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND l.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(p.SEX = 'M') > SUM(p.SEX = 'F') AS answer
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT l.ID, l."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (l.FG < 150 OR l.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND L.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.IGG > 900 AND l.IGG < 2000
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRP = '+'
  AND p.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(Patient.Birthday)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND e.KCT = '+';
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20 AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(Patient.Birthday)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.C4 > 10;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.SM IN ('negative', '0') AND T3.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT DISTINCT L.ID
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Examination E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE E."Examination Date" > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-','+-') AND YEAR(T1.`First Date`) < 2000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN p.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN l.ID END) * 1.0 / COUNT(l.ID) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(Birthday) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE GOT >= 60)
SELECT MIN(T1."First Date") FROM Patient AS T1 WHERE T1.ID = (SELECT T2.ID FROM Laboratory AS T2 WHERE T2.LDH < 500 ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.ALB > 3.5 AND L.ALB < 5.5
  AND L.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
SELECT T1.ID FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.CRE < 1.5 ORDER BY T2.`aCL IgA` DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(a.atom_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element
LIMIT 3;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '-')
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;
SELECT bond_type FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_type ASC LIMIT 2

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT DISTINCT a.element FROM atom a WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)
  AND a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT a1.atom_id AS atom_id1, a1.element AS element1, a2.atom_id AS atom_id2, a2.element AS element2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id
FROM connected AS T1
INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id
INNER JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T3.element = 'pb'

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / SUM(cnt) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a1.element ELSE a2.element END AS e1,
           CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a2.element ELSE a1.element END AS e2,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY 1, 2
) t;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';
SELECT molecule_id, label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002');

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS has_both
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';
SELECT element, count(*) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' GROUP BY element

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151' AND label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds, m.label AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type)
        FROM bond b
        WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id) AS bond_type_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT DISTINCT a1.molecule_id
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM atom a2
        JOIN molecule m2 ON m2.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY a2.molecule_id
    ) t
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Eligible Free Rate`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY `Eligible Free Rate` ASC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT T2.School FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1
SELECT T2.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500
SELECT T1.District FROM schools AS T1 JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Active' GROUP BY T1.District ORDER BY AVG(T2.AvgScrRead) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(s.cds) FROM schools AS sc JOIN satscores AS s ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Merged' AND sc.County = 'Alameda' AND s.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT satscores.AvgScrWrite, schools.CharterNum
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND schools.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC;
SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside' GROUP BY T2.CDSCode HAVING SUM(T1.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(T1.cds) > 400

SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.City = 'Monterey'
  AND T1.`School Type` = 'High Schools'
  AND T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally Funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm f2
      WHERE f2.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally Funded'
  )
SELECT "Free Meal Count (K-12)" / "Enrollment (K-12)" AS "Eligible Free Rate" FROM frpm ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9
SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'
SELECT schools.AdmEmail1 FROM frpm JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE frpm.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 ORDER BY frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(satscores.NumTstTakr) 
FROM satscores 
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE schools.City = 'Fresno' AND schools.OpenDate LIKE '1980%';

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.School FROM schools AS T2 JOIN frpm AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.CDSCode WHERE T2.DOC = 31 ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT y.Segment, y.CustomerID, y.total
    FROM yearly y
    JOIN mins m ON y.Segment = m.Segment AND y.total = m.min_total
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

WITH seg_total AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM seg_total
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT st.Segment, SUM(st.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM seg_total st
    JOIN min_seg ms ON st.Segment = ms.Segment AND st.total_consumption = ms.min_consumption
    GROUP BY st.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH min_cons AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS seg, MIN(ym.Consumption) AS min_c
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS seg, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_c, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    JOIN min_cons m ON c.Segment = m.seg AND ym.Consumption = m.min_c
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
avg_c AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN seg = 'SME' THEN CAST(total_c AS REAL) / cnt END) AS sme_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN seg = 'LAM' THEN CAST(total_c AS REAL) / cnt END) AS lam_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN seg = 'KAM' THEN CAST(total_c AS REAL) / cnt END) AS kam_avg
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    sme_avg - lam_avg AS diff_SME_LAM,
    lam_avg - kam_avg AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    kam_avg - sme_avg AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM avg_c;

JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN Country C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name
FROM (
  SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
  UNION SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
) pm
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = pm.player_api_id
JOIN Country c ON c.id = pm.country_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - MIN(d.A11) AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
               FROM client c2
               JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id
               WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
                 AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F'))
GROUP BY a.account_id;

WITH combos AS (
    SELECT c.bond_id, a1.element AS e1, a2.element AS e2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
),
counts AS (
    SELECT e1, e2, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM combos
    GROUP BY e1, e2
)
SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT cnt FROM counts ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM combos) AS percentage;

SELECT
  (
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(*)
     FROM customers AS T1
     JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
     WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
       AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
       AND T2.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T4.Consumption)
                             FROM customers AS T3
                             JOIN yearmonth AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                             WHERE T3.Segment = 'SME' AND T3.Currency = 'CZK'
                               AND T4.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
    -
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(*)
     FROM customers AS T1
     JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
     WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
       AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
       AND T2.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T4.Consumption)
                             FROM customers AS T3
                             JOIN yearmonth AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                             WHERE T3.Segment = 'LAM' AND T3.Currency = 'CZK'
                               AND T4.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  ) AS difference_SME_LAM,
  (
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(*)
     FROM customers AS T1
     JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
     WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
       AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
       AND T2.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T4.Consumption)
                             FROM customers AS T3
                             JOIN yearmonth AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                             WHERE T3.Segment = 'LAM' AND T3.Currency = 'CZK'
                               AND T4.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
    -
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(*)
     FROM customers AS T1
     JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
     WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
       AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
       AND T2.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T4.Consumption)
                             FROM customers AS T3
                             JOIN yearmonth AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                             WHERE T3.Segment = 'KAM' AND T3.Currency = 'CZK'
                               AND T4.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  ) AS difference_LAM_KAM,
  (
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(*)
     FROM customers AS T1
     JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
     WHERE T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
       AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
       AND T2.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T4.Consumption)
                             FROM customers AS T3
                             JOIN yearmonth AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                             WHERE T3.Segment = 'KAM' AND T3.Currency = 'CZK'
                               AND T4.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
    -
    (SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) / COUNT(*)
     FROM customers AS T1
     JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
     WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T1.Currency = 'CZK'
       AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
       AND T2.Consumption = (SELECT MIN(T4.Consumption)
                             FROM customers AS T3
                             JOIN yearmonth AS T4 ON T3.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
                             WHERE T3.Segment = 'SME' AND T3.Currency = 'CZK'
                               AND T4.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312))
  ) AS difference_KAM_SME;
