SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id 
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm)
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human'
  AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM hero_attribute 
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id 
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute ORDER BY attribute_value LIMIT 1
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100 AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT T1.id
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT p.ID, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', p.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.Date) AS Lab_Date,
       STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday))
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';
SELECT T2.`aCL IgM` FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19' AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12'
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Examination WHERE Thrombosis = 2 AND ANA = 'S' AND `aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 1.2 FROM Examination)

SELECT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123;
SELECT MAX(Symptoms) FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' 
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'Behcet' 
  AND T1.Admission = '-'

SELECT JULIANDAY(Examination.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(Patient.`First Date`)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT L.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID,
       CASE
           WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
           ELSE 'No'
       END AS ALB_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T1.UA) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Date = (SELECT MAX(Date) FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = T1.ID) AND (T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0 OR T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5)

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, SEX, Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Diagnosis = 'RA' AND UN < 30;
SELECT T1.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 GROUP BY T1.SEX;

SELECT Patient.ID, Laboratory."T-CHO"
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND l.FG NOT BETWEEN 150 AND 450;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2."U-PRO" >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+' AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 0 AND T3.C4 > 10;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT DISTINCT Examination.ID
FROM Examination
JOIN Laboratory ON Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Examination."Examination Date" > '1997-01-01'
  AND Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND E.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN ('-','+-') 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) 
FROM Laboratory 
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8 AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0 / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) 
FROM Laboratory 
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(Birthday) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE GOT >= 60);

SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500)
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB = (SELECT MAX(ALB) FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.ALB > 3.5
  AND Laboratory.ALB < 5.5
  AND Laboratory.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;
SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5 AND T3.`aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0 AND e."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%';
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1);

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM connected
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT T3.atom_id, T3.atom_id2
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element
LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type = '-'
  AND c.atom_id <> c.atom_id2
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND bond.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(bond.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id2 AS atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT T2.atom_id AS atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / SUM(cnt) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY MIN(a1.element, a2.element), MAX(a1.element, a2.element)
);

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id), 5)
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.element)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T3.bond_type = '-';

SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected
    JOIN atom AS a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
      AND 'cl' IN (a1.element, a2.element)
      AND 'c' IN (a1.element, a2.element)
);

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT bond.bond_id, molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT T.element, COUNT(T.element)
FROM atom AS T
JOIN molecule AS M ON T.molecule_id = M.molecule_id
WHERE M.label = '+' AND substr(T.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY T.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM atom a 
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id 
FROM bond AS T1 
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id 
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T2.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = 'TR006' AND bond.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY molecule.label;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM connected AS T1 
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id 
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id 
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl';

SELECT atom.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_type) AS num_bond_types
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY atom.atom_id;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'cl' AND molecule.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'c' AND T1.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T3.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(atom.molecule_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(atom_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count
        FROM atom
        WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+')
        GROUP BY molecule_id
    )
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id)
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'o' AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation Education'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T1.School
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND T1.Magnet = 1;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT T2.District
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T2.District
ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(T1.School)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T1.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    sa.sname,
    sc.CharterNum,
    sa.AvgScrWrite,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS writing_rank
FROM satscores sa
JOIN schools sc ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sa.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sa.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.School
HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`School Type` = 'High Schools';

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally Funded'
  AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T3
      JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally Funded'
  );

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Eligible Free Rate (K-12)`
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` 
FROM schools AS T1 
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT schools.AdmEmail1
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.School FROM schools AS T2 INNER JOIN frpm AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.CDSCode WHERE T2.DOC = 31 ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT schools.MailStreet, schools.School
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 6, 1

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM satscores s 
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode 
WHERE (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500 
  AND sc.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

SELECT Website 
FROM schools 
WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
   OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
   OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez');
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND County = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm AS T1 
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           ym.CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
segment_mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avgs AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN segment_mins sm
      ON ct.Segment = sm.Segment
     AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
        - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE alignment.id = 2;

SELECT T1.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute AS T1
JOIN attribute AS T2 ON T1.attribute_id = T2.id
JOIN superhero AS T3 ON T1.hero_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND T3.superhero_name = 'Hulk';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) 
FROM superhero AS T1 
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id 
JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id 
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM hero_attribute 
INNER JOIN attribute ON attribute.id = hero_attribute.attribute_id 
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' 
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute WHERE attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien';

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.colour = 'Brown' AND T1.weight_kg < 100;

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT T1.hero_id
FROM hero_power AS T1
INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT T2.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T3 ON T1.id = T3.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T3.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(ID) AS percentage_inpatient
FROM Patient
WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31'
SELECT T2.ID, SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(T2.Birthday)) FROM Patient AS T2 JOIN Examination AS T1 ON T2.ID = T1.ID WHERE T1.RVVT = '+'

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5

SELECT T2.Date, (strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday))
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
       SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM` 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19' 
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12'
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date = '1992-06-12' AND T2.GPT = '9'

SELECT SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) - SUBSTR(T1.Birthday, 1, 4)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.UA = '8.4' AND T2.Date = '1991-10-21'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT COUNT(ID) AS num_patients, GROUP_CONCAT(ID) AS patient_ids
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND YEAR(Birthday) = 1964
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2 AND T2.`ANA Pattern` = 'S' AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 1.2 FROM Examination)

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS' 
  AND T3.CRP > 2 
  AND T3.CRE = 1 
  AND T3.LDH = 123;
SELECT Symptoms FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' GROUP BY Symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND E.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND P.Admission = '-';

SELECT DATEDIFF(`Examination Date`, `First Date`)
FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', T1.Birthday) = '1982-04-01'

SELECT T1.ID, T1.Date, T1.TP - 8.5 AS Deviation
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.TP > 8.5

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC

SELECT P.ID,
       L.ALB,
       CASE WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range' ELSE 'Not within normal range' END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE YEAR(P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(L.UA)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.Date = (SELECT MAX(L2.Date) FROM Laboratory L2 WHERE L2.ID = P.ID)
  AND ((P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0) OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5));

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND T2.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F')
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5

SELECT Patient.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.`T-CHO`
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
ORDER BY T1.`T-CHO` DESC, T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(T1.Birthday)) < 70;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.KCT = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RF < 20 AND YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(T1.Birthday) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T3.C4 > 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) 
FROM Patient P 
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID 
WHERE L.SSA IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND YEAR(P.`First Date`) < 2000;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN T1.ID END) * 1.0 / COUNT(T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60
SELECT T1.`First Date` FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH < 500 ORDER BY T2.LDH DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
ORDER BY T3.`aCL IgA` DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TG < 200 ORDER BY T2.TG DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) 
FROM molecule m 
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id 
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T1.atom_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T3.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-';
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element ASC LIMIT 3;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id, bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT T2.label
FROM bond AS T1
INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id, T2.label
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.atom_id2 
FROM connected AS T1 
INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id 
WHERE T2.element = 'pb'

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT a1.element, a2.element, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) t;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id), 5) AS carcinogenic_percentage
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.element) 
FROM atom AS T1 
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T2.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS result
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
    OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'));

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(atom.element) 
FROM atom 
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE molecule.label = '+' 
  AND SUBSTR(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4';

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM atom 
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, m.label AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl';

SELECT T3.atom_id, COUNT(T1.bond_type)
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T1.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id
WHERE T4.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T3.atom_id;

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T2.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4' AND T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.molecule_id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) 
FROM atom a 
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id 
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id 
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation High School'
ORDER BY frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T1.sname
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CDSCode 
FROM frpm 
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT s.dname
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.dname
ORDER BY AVG(s.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) 
FROM schools AS T1 
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds 
WHERE T1.County = 'Alameda' 
  AND T1.StatusType = 'Merged' 
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT s.School, s.CharterNum
FROM satscores t
JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE t.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY t.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.cname = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.School
HAVING SUM(T1.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(T2.School) > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm f2
      JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` 
FROM frpm 
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC 
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT CAST(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS REAL) / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson';

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) 
FROM satscores AS T1 
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980' AND T2.County = 'Fresno';

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, s.DOC, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.sname, T2.MailStreet
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 6, 1;

WITH customer_annual AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, for CZK customers in the three segments
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS y
      ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'      -- year 2013 (Date between 201301 and 201312)
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
lowest_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest annual consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment,
           MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_annual
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption of the lowest-consuming customers / their count
    SELECT ca.Segment,
           SUM(ca.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM customer_annual AS ca
    JOIN lowest_per_segment AS l
      ON ca.Segment = l.Segment
     AND ca.total_consumption = l.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ca.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND attribute.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.skin_colour_id = T2.id
JOIN alignment AS T3 ON T1.alignment_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.colour = 'Green' AND T3.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm)
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human'
  AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM hero_attribute AS ha
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND ha.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute ORDER BY attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.weight_kg < 100 AND T2.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT T1.weight_kg, T2.race 
FROM superhero AS T1 
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id 
WHERE T1.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT T1.hero_id
FROM hero_power AS T1
INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero)

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT T1.ID, strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+'

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) - MIN(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT T1.`Date`,
       strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'

SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.Date) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` = T2.`First Date`
  AND T1.ID IN (
      SELECT ID
      FROM Examination
      WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
        AND `Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  )

SELECT COUNT(ID) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE SEX = 'F' 
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' 
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
FROM Examination
WHERE Thrombosis = 2
  AND ANA = 'S'
  AND `aCL IgM` > (
      SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`)
      FROM Examination
      WHERE Thrombosis = 2
        AND ANA = 'S'
  ) * 1.2;

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS' 
  AND T3.CRP > 2 
  AND T3.CRE = 1 
  AND T3.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND T1.Admission = '-'

SELECT JULIANDAY(T1.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(T2.`First Date`)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y-%m-%d', T1.Birthday) = '1982-04-01'

SELECT L.TP - 8.5
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    T1.ID,
    CASE 
        WHEN T2.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS ALB_Within_Normal_Range
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T1.UA) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Date = (SELECT MAX(Date) FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = T1.ID) 
  AND ((T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0) OR (T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND T2.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE `T-BIL` >= 2.0 
GROUP BY SEX;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.`T-CHO`
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
ORDER BY T1.`T-CHO` DESC, T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01' 
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` > 0 AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30 AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T1.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T3.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'APS' AND T2.C4 > 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.SM IN ('negative', '0') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.DNA < 8
  AND P.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(Laboratory.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;

SELECT T1.Birthday 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60 
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.LDH = (
    SELECT MAX(LDH) 
    FROM Laboratory 
    WHERE LDH < 500
);

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T2.ID 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.CRE < 1.5 
ORDER BY T2."aCL IgA" DESC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Laboratory AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%'
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T3.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(T1.atom_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T3.molecule_id = T4.molecule_id
WHERE T4.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(atom.element = 'c') * 100.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T3.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element
LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') FROM molecule;

SELECT molecule_id
FROM molecule
WHERE label = '-'
  AND molecule_id IN (
      SELECT molecule_id
      FROM bond
      WHERE bond_type = '-'
  )
ORDER BY molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT m.label = '+' AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#' AND T2.molecule_id = 'TR041'

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.atom_id2
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected) AS percentage
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT printf('%.5f',
    SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
    / COUNT(bond.bond_id)
) AS proportion
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.element) 
FROM bond AS T1 
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T1.bond_type = '-';

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND bond_id IN (
      SELECT c.bond_id
      FROM connected c
      JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
      WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  )
  AND bond_id IN (
      SELECT c.bond_id
      FROM connected c
      JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
      WHERE a.element = 'c'
  );

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) 
FROM molecule AS T1 
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.bond_type = '-';

SELECT bond.bond_id,
       CASE 
           WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
           WHEN molecule.label = '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
  AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM atom 
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE molecule.label = '+'

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T2.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds, molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR006' AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl';

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T2.bond_type)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T1.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM atom 
    WHERE element = 's'
) 
AND molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id 
    FROM bond 
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
);

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id 
FROM molecule AS T1 
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T1.label = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT T1.molecule_id 
FROM atom AS T1 
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT T2.molecule_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T1.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T2.element = 's' AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '+'
GROUP BY T1.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.molecule_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id)
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE atom.element = 'o' AND bond.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT T2.School,
       T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS EligibleFreeRate
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.SOCType = 'Continuation Education'
ORDER BY EligibleFreeRate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T1.sname
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.District
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T2.District
ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) 
FROM schools AS T1 
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds 
WHERE T1.County = 'Alameda' 
  AND T1.StatusType = 'Merged' 
  AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT T2.CharterNum, T1.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrWrite > 499
AND T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY T2.School, T2.FundingType
HAVING AVG(T1.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Monterey'
  AND T1.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'
  AND T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT T1.School, T1.DOCType
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
  AND T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > (
      SELECT AVG(`Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm
      WHERE `Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
  )

SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Eligible Free Rate (K-12)`
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Eligible Free Rate (Ages 5-17)`
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(T2.NumTstTakr) 
FROM schools AS T1 
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds 
WHERE T1.County = 'Fresno' 
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >
             SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        THEN 'In-patients (Admission = +)'
        ELSE 'Outpatients (Admission = -)'
    END AS more_frequent_group,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) * 1.0
        / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END), 0) AS in_to_out_ratio,
    ABS(
        COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) * 1.0
        / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END), 0) - 1
    ) * 100 AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.bond_id) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(bond_id) FROM connected) AS percentage
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
GROUP BY T2.element, T3.element
HAVING COUNT(T1.bond_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(t.mycount)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS mycount
        FROM connected AS c
        JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
        JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
        GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
    ) AS t
);

WITH seg_cust AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_cons
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_cons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_cons) AS min_total
    FROM seg_cust
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT s.Segment, SUM(s.total_cons) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM seg_cust s
    JOIN min_cons m ON s.Segment = m.Segment AND s.total_cons = m.min_total
    GROUP BY s.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff;

JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T4 ON T3.bond_id = T4.bond_id
WHERE T2.element = 's' AND T4.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM atom a2
        JOIN molecule m2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY a2.molecule_id
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) 
FROM atom a

JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)

WITH totals AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per customer, for CZK-paying customers only
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        y.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    INNER JOIN customers AS c 
        ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
lowest AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average consumption of the least-consuming customer(s) per segment
    -- (total consumption of the lowest / number of customers tied at the lowest)
    SELECT 
        t.Segment,
        SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption
    FROM totals AS t
    INNER JOIN lowest AS l 
        ON t.Segment = l.Segment 
       AND t.total_consumption = l.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;
