SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

SELECT major.major_name, major.department
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Garrett' AND member.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, g.college
FROM member m
JOIN major g ON m.link_to_major = g.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Secretary';

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent, e.event_name
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;

SELECT T2.city
FROM member AS T1
JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code
WHERE T1.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T1.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
GROUP BY T1.full_name
HAVING COUNT(T1.full_name) > 15

SELECT COUNT(superhero.id) AS num_superheroes
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT T1.superhero_name, T1.height_cm
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY T1.height_cm DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id 
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'DC Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(s.id) AS percentage,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 END) AS marvel_count
FROM superhero AS s
INNER JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
INNER JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;
SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek';

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(T1.weight_kg) 
FROM superhero AS T1 
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id 
WHERE T2.gender = 'Female'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Alien';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'human';

SELECT T2.power_name 
FROM hero_power AS T1 
INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 
ON T1.power_id = T2.id 
WHERE T1.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(superhero.id) / SUM(superhero.skin_colour_id = 1) AS average
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT superhero.height_cm
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT c2.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

SELECT (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky')
     - (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS weight_difference;

SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(id) AS average_height
FROM superhero;

SELECT colour.colour
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT alignment.alignment, superpower.power_name
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT T1.superhero_name 
FROM superhero AS T1 
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id 
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id 
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id 
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'Male';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm)
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human'
  AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(hero_id) 
FROM hero_attribute 
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id 
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' 
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT hero_id 
FROM hero_attribute 
ORDER BY attribute_value ASC 
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.full_name 
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100 AND c.colour = 'brown';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT T1.hero_id
FROM hero_power AS T1
INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.power_name = 'Intelligence'

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
        / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(strftime('%Y', Birthday)) - MIN(strftime('%Y', Birthday))
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT T1.Date, T2.`First Date` - T2.Birthday
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN p.ID END) * 1.0
  /
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN p.ID END)
  AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l
  ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'

SELECT E.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND P.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'

SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(Laboratory.Date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(Patient.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.UA = '8.4'
  AND Laboratory.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) + (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 0.2;

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms, COUNT(Symptoms) AS frequency
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY frequency DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' 
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET' 
  AND T1.Admission = '-';
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT T1.ID 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01' 
  AND T2.ALP < 300;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.TP - 8.5
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.TP > 8.5

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND (L.ALB <= 3.5 OR L.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT P.ID,
       L.ALB,
       CASE 
           WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' 
           ELSE 'No' 
       END AS 'ALB within normal range'
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(L.UA) AS Average_UA_Index
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.Date = (
    SELECT MAX(L2.Date)
    FROM Laboratory L2
    WHERE L2.ID = P.ID
)
  AND ((P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA < 8.0)
    OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA < 6.5));

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND T2.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patient_List
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT T2.ID, T1.`T-CHO`
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
ORDER BY T1.`T-CHO` DESC, T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT T2.Diagnosis
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE `IGG` >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900
  AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-') 
  AND T3.KCT = '+'

SELECT T1.ID 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.RF < 20 
  AND strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) > 60

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 'venous' 
  AND T3.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '0')
  AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory AS T2
JOIN Patient AS T1 ON T2.ID = T1.ID
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60;

SELECT T1.Birthday 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GOT >= 60 
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH < 500
GROUP BY P.ID
ORDER BY MAX(L.LDH) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5 
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
GROUP BY T1.ID
ORDER BY MAX(T3.`aCL IgA`) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T2.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
GROUP BY T1.ID
ORDER BY MAX(T2.TG) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.element = 'cl'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM bond
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
JOIN atom ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'
UNION
SELECT T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT T2.element
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY T2.element ASC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '-');

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'
  AND molecule.label = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id;

SELECT a1.element AS atom1, a2.element AS atom2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY b.molecule_id
ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.element = 'pb'

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / SUM(cnt) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT a1.element, a2.element, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id  = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) t;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 
       / COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS percentage
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom AS a
JOIN bond AS b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2 THEN 1 
         ELSE 0 
       END AS has_both_cl_and_c
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a 
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule AS T1
INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.label = '-' AND T2.bond_type = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       m.label,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
            ELSE 'non-carcinogenic'
       END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(a.element) AS element_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4';

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(bond_id), 
        2
    ) AS percent
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) 
FROM atom 
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id 
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT T2.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T2
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND T3.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT T1.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T2.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl'

SELECT a.atom_id,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type)
          FROM bond b
         WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR346') AS bond_type_count
  FROM atom a
 WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR346';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 's'
)
AND molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
)

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T2.label = '-'

SELECT T2.molecule_id
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND T1.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c 
    ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b 
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT M.molecule_id
FROM molecule M
JOIN atom A ON M.molecule_id = A.molecule_id
WHERE M.label = '+'
GROUP BY M.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(A.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(atom_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(A2.atom_id) AS atom_count
        FROM atom A2
        JOIN molecule M2 ON A2.molecule_id = M2.molecule_id
        WHERE M2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY A2.molecule_id
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 'o' AND T3.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS num_molecules
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    frpm."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools 
    ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT satscores.sname
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND schools.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sc.District
FROM satscores sa
JOIN schools sc ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY sc.District
ORDER BY AVG(sa.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.cds)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T2.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS writing_score_rank,
    T1.sname AS school_name,
    T2.CharterNum,
    T1.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND T2.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM satscores AS t
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(t.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT 
    s.School, 
    s.Street, 
    s.City, 
    s.State, 
    s.Zip
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f 
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND s.GSoffered = '9-12';

SELECT schools.School, schools.DOCType
FROM schools
JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` - frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm f
      JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
      WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  )

SELECT 
    `Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE (T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson')
   OR (T1.AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName2 = 'Gibson')
   OR (T1.AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName3 = 'Gibson');

SELECT T2.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) AS avg_test_takers
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno'

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.School
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.DOC = 31
ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    T1.sname AS School_Name,
    T2.MailStreet AS Postal_Street_Address
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_schools
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

WHERE T1.County = 'Los Angeles'

FROM schools

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11

SELECT
    -- Part 1: total count of magnet K-8 schools offering Multiple Provision Types
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
       FROM schools s2
       INNER JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.Magnet = 1
        AND s2.GSserved = 'K-8'
        AND f2.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
    ) AS num_schools_multiple_provision_types,
    -- Part 2: per-city listing of K-8 schools
    T2.City,
    COUNT(T2.CDSCode) AS num_schools_per_city
FROM schools AS T2
INNER JOIN frpm AS T1 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.Magnet = 1
  AND T2.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY T2.City;

SELECT T1.`District Code`,

       / COUNT(*) AS pct_LAM_customers

    SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'

    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'euro'

);

FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating > (
        -- average overall rating in 2010
        SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
        FROM Player_Attributes
        WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
      )
  AND overall_rating = (
        -- the highest overall rating (that is above average) in 2010
        SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
        FROM Player_Attributes
        WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010'
      );

JOIN account  AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
JOIN district AS T4 ON T1.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
  AND T1.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date)
                       FROM client
                       WHERE gender = 'F')
GROUP BY T3.account_id
HAVING MIN(T4.A11) = (SELECT MIN(T4.A11)
                      FROM client AS T1
                      JOIN district AS T4 ON T1.district_id = T4.district_id

FROM member AS T1
JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
JOIN event AS T3 ON T2.link_to_event = T3.event_id
WHERE T1.position = 'Member'
  AND T3.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT event_name
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Game'
  AND status = 'Closed'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20';

SELECT DISTINCT 
    m.first_name, 
    m.last_name, 
    a.link_to_event
FROM expense e
JOIN member m 
    ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN attendance a 
    ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
WHERE e.approved = 'true'
  AND e.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT DISTINCT member.email
FROM expense
JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE expense.cost > 20
  AND expense.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE member.position = 'Member'
  AND major.major_name = 'Education'
  AND major.college = 'College of Education & Human Services';

SELECT expense_description
FROM expense
GROUP BY expense_description
HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50;

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
GROUP BY T1.member_id
ORDER BY MAX(T2.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name, 
       T1.last_name, 
       T1.phone
FROM member AS T1
JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

SELECT T1.major_name, T1.department
FROM major AS T1
JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major
WHERE T2.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T2.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT 
    m.last_name,
    m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Elementary Education';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, mj.college
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Secretary';

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;

SELECT T1.city
FROM zip_code AS T1
JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.zip_code = T2.zip
WHERE T2.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T2.last_name = 'Gerke';

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
GROUP BY T1.id
HAVING COUNT(T1.full_name) > 15;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id 
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'DC Comics';

SELECT superhero.superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY hero_attribute.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
        / COUNT(s.id) AS percentage_bad,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_bad_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.id = 75;

SELECT AVG(T1.weight_kg) AS average_weight
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.gender = 'Female';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.race = 'Alien';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND T2.colour = 'No Colour';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God';

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'Human';

SELECT T2.power_name
FROM hero_power AS T1
INNER JOIN superpower AS T2
    ON T1.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.hero_id = 1;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(superhero.id) * 1.0 / SUM(superhero.skin_colour_id = 1) AS average
FROM superhero;

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT T1.height_cm
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.colour = 'Amber';

SELECT c2.colour AS eye_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Vampire';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) 
     FROM superhero 
     WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky')
    -
    (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) 
     FROM superhero 
     WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS difference;

SELECT 
    superhero_name,
    SUM(height_cm) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS average_height
FROM superhero
GROUP BY superhero_name;

SELECT colour.colour
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT DISTINCT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(superhero.id) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero
INNER JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
INNER JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE alignment.id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green'
  AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm)
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human'
  AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_superheroes_count
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_attribute ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'brown';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'neutral';

SELECT T1.hero_id 
FROM hero_power AS T1 
INNER JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T1.power_id = T2.id 
WHERE T2.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS in_patient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS outpatient_count,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
        / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage_deviation
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT T1.ID,
       strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT
    P.ID,
    P.SEX,
    P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) 
     - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE TG >= 200
);

SELECT T1.Date,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age_at_First_Visit
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) /
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m-%d', T2.Date) BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT T2.`aCL IgM`
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12';

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GPT = '9'
  AND L.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS num_patients
FROM Examination
WHERE Thrombosis = 2
  AND `ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND `aCL IgM` > (
        SELECT (AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`)) * 0.2
        FROM Examination
      );

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND T3.CRP > 2
  AND T3.CRE = 1
  AND T3.LDH = 123;

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) AS percentage_of_women
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND T1.Admission = '-'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997';

SELECT
    JULIANDAY(MIN(e."Examination Date")) - JULIANDAY(p."First Date") AS days_to_evaluation
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;

SELECT 
    T1.ID, 
    T2.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 
    ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '04/01/1982';

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.TP,
    L.TP - 8.5 AS TP_Deviation_From_Normal
FROM 
    Patient AS P
    JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE 
    P.SEX = 'F'
    AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT 
    p.ID, 
    p.SEX, 
    p.Birthday, 
    p.Description, 
    p."First Date", 
    p.Admission, 
    p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND (l.ALB <= 3.5 OR l.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY p.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    P.ID,
    L.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
        ELSE 'Out of normal range'
    END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(T3.UA)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.Date = (
        SELECT MAX(T2.Date)
        FROM Laboratory AS T2
        WHERE T2.ID = T1.ID
      )
  AND (
        (T1.SEX = 'M' AND T3.UA < 8.0)
     OR (T1.SEX = 'F' AND T3.UA < 6.5)
      );

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT 
    T1.SEX, 
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2."T-BIL" >= 2.0
GROUP BY T1.SEX;

SELECT T1.ID, T1."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.APTT > 45 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01' 
  AND (T2.FG < 150 OR T2.FG > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2."U-PRO" >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` > 0
  AND T2.`U-PRO` < 30
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.IGG > 900
  AND l.IGG < 2000
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+' 
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) 
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T1.KCT = '+'

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND Laboratory.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID 
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1."Examination Date" > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND T2.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN L.GOT >= 60 AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 
       / COUNT(CASE WHEN L.GOT >= 60 THEN 1 END) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID;

SELECT MAX(T2.Birthday)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE P.ID = (
    SELECT L.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L.LDH < 500
    ORDER BY L.LDH DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT `Examination Date`
FROM Examination
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
    ORDER BY ALB DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) AS highest_ANA
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
  AND T1."aCL IgA" = (
        SELECT MAX(T3."aCL IgA")
        FROM Examination AS T3
        INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T4 ON T3.ID = T4.ID
        WHERE T4.CRE < 1.5
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) 
FROM molecule m 
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id 
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(
         (SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM bond b
          JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
          WHERE m.label = '+'          -- carcinogenic molecules
            AND b.bond_type = '-')     -- single bonds
       AS REAL)
       /
       (SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id)
        FROM atom a
        JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
        WHERE m.label = '+')           -- atoms in carcinogenic molecules
       AS avg_single_bonded;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) 
       / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT bond.molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T1.bond_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY T1.bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT 
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'not carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT DISTINCT T2.element
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' 
  AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond AS b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' 
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id  = a.atom_id
JOIN atom pb     ON pb.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE pb.element = 'pb'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
JOIN atom pb     ON pb.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE pb.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY MIN(a1.element, a2.element), MAX(a1.element, a2.element)
);

SELECT ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id),
    5
) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT CASE
         WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) = 2 THEN 'Yes'
         ELSE 'No'
       END AS bond_has_chlorine_and_carbon
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a
  ON a.atom_id IN (c.atom_id, c.atom_id2)
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  AND a.element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-'
  AND bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    CASE m.label
        WHEN '+' THEN 'carcinogenic'
        WHEN '-' THEN 'non-carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT a.element, COUNT(a.element) AS tally
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND substr(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY a.element;

SELECT T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.element = 'ca';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 
         ELSE 0 
       END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151'
  AND label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
  AND T3.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT atom.atom_id
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count,
       (SELECT label 
        FROM molecule 
        WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006') AS carcinogenic_label
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' 
  AND bond_type = '=';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T2.bond_type)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T1.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule 
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id 
        FROM atom 
        WHERE element = 's'
      ) 
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (
        SELECT molecule_id 
        FROM bond 
        WHERE bond_type = ' = '
      );

SELECT molecule.label
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT T1.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.element = 'cl'
  AND T1.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT m.label
FROM atom AS a1
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a1.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 's' AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(atom.molecule_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS total_molecules
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id)
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT f.`School Name`,
       f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN schools s
        ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
  AND f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND sc.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.dname
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T1.cds) AS num_schools
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT 
    satscores.sname,
    schools.CharterNum,
    satscores.AvgScrWrite,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS writing_rank
FROM satscores
JOIN schools 
    ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND schools.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT s.sname, sc.FundingType
FROM schools AS sc
INNER JOIN satscores AS s ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE sc.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.sname
HAVING AVG(s.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT
    s.School,      -- school name
    s.Street,      -- full communication address
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s
        ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Monterey'
  AND f.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'
  AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT T1.School, T1.DOCType
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T3
      INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT 
    `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT 
    T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 
    ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE (T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson')
   OR (T1.AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName2 = 'Gibson')
   OR (T1.AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName3 = 'Gibson');

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr) AS average_test_takers
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.County = 'Fresno'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', sc.OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School,
       f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f
  ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '31'                              -- State Special Schools
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` = (                 -- grades 1–12 enrollment (K-12)
        SELECT MAX(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)`)
        FROM frpm f2
        JOIN schools s2
          ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
        WHERE s2.DOC = '31'
  );

SELECT 
    T2.MailStreet,
    T1.sname
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 
    ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 6, 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_schools
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE (satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500
  AND schools.MailCity = 'Lakeport';

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE CDSCode IN (
        SELECT CDSCode
        FROM schools
        WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson')
           OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson')
           OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson')
      )
  AND CDSCode IN (
        SELECT CDSCode
        FROM schools
        WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez')
           OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez')
           OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez')
      );

SELECT Website
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'San Joaquin'
  AND Virtual = 'P'
  AND Charter = 1;

SELECT COUNT(T2.CDSCode)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.Charter = 0
  AND (T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)`) < 0.18;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_schools
FROM schools
WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman'
  AND CharterNum = '00D4';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_directly_funded_schools
FROM schools
WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded'
  AND County = 'Stanislaus'
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2000' AND '12/31/2005';

SELECT County
FROM schools
WHERE SOC = 11
  AND strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s 
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f.`Low Grade` = 'K'
  AND f.`High Grade` = '9';

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(GSserved) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    schools.City, 
    frpm.`Low Grade`, 
    schools.School
FROM schools
INNER JOIN frpm 
    ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY schools.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND s.GSserved = 'K-8'
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types';

SELECT 
    frpm.`District Code`,
    frpm.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM frpm
JOIN schools 
    ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'
   OR schools.AdmFName2 = 'Alusine'
   OR schools.AdmFName3 = 'Alusine';

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND City = 'San Bernardino'
  AND SOC = 62
  AND DOC = 54
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2009' AND '12/31/2010';

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
ORDER BY Views DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT MAX(p.AnswerCount) AS AnswerCount

JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id

SELECT DISTINCT users.DisplayName
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id

SELECT posts.Body

SELECT COUNT(*) AS badge_count
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore

JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT COUNT(c.Id) AS CommentCount
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ViewCount = 1910;

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id

SELECT users.DisplayName AS EditorDisplayName
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.LastEditorUserId = users.Id
WHERE posts.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data?';

SELECT SUM(v.BountyAmount) AS TotalBountyAmount
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data%';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE v.BountyAmount = 50
  AND p.Title LIKE '%variance%';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_users
FROM users u
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%New York%'
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM badges b
        WHERE b.UserId = u.Id
          AND b.Name = 'Supporter'
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM badges b
        WHERE b.UserId = u.Id
          AND b.Name = 'Teachers'
      );

SELECT DISTINCT ph.UserId
FROM postHistory AS ph
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = ph.UserId
WHERE u.Views >= 1000
GROUP BY ph.UserId, ph.PostId
HAVING COUNT(ph.Id) = 1;

SELECT 
    u.Id AS UserId,
    u.DisplayName,
    b.Name AS BadgeName,
    b.Date AS BadgeDate
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Id IN (
    -- Find the user(s) with the maximum number of comments
    SELECT UserId
    FROM comments
    GROUP BY UserId
    HAVING COUNT(Id) = (
        SELECT MAX(total_comments)
        FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(Id) AS total_comments
            FROM comments
            GROUP BY UserId
        ) AS comment_counts
    )
)
ORDER BY u.Id, b.Date;

SELECT
    ph.PostHistoryTypeId,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.UserId)
     FROM comments c
     WHERE c.PostId = 3720
       AND c.UserId IS NOT NULL) AS UniqueCommenterCount
FROM postHistory ph
WHERE ph.PostId = 3720;

SELECT p.Score, pl.LinkTypeId
FROM posts p
JOIN postLinks pl ON p.Id = pl.PostId
WHERE p.Id = 395;

SELECT AVG(u.UpVotes) AS avg_up_votes,
       AVG(u.Age)     AS avg_user_age
FROM users u
WHERE u.Id IN (
        SELECT p.OwnerUserId
        FROM posts p
        GROUP BY p.OwnerUserId
        HAVING COUNT(p.Id) > 10
      );

SELECT badges.Date
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.Location = 'Rochester, NY';

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Name = 'Teacher' THEN UserId END) AS REAL) 
        * 100 / COUNT(UserId) AS TeacherPercentage
FROM badges;

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.CreaionDate = '2010-07-19 19:37:33.0';

SELECT DISTINCT u.Age
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE u.Location = 'Vienna, Austria';

SELECT badges.Name
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName = 'Sharpie';

SELECT DISTINCT t.TagName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
JOIN tags t  ON t.ExcerptPostId = p.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'John Salvatier';

SELECT users.DisplayName,
       SUM(posts.ViewCount) AS TotalViewCount
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE users.DisplayName IN ('Harvey Motulsky', 'Noah Snyder')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) AS user_count
FROM badges
WHERE Name = 'Commentator'

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%North Pole%'
  AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011';

SELECT users.DisplayName, users.WebsiteUrl
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE posts.FavoriteCount > 150;

SELECT 
    p.Title,
    COUNT(ph.Id) AS PostHistoryCount,
    p.LastEditDate

LEFT JOIN postHistory ph 
    ON ph.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'What is the best introductory Bayesian statistics textbook?'

    p.Title,

SELECT users.LastAccessDate, users.Location
FROM badges
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id
WHERE badges.Name = 'Outliers';

SELECT OwnerUserId
FROM posts
ORDER BY FavoriteCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
ORDER BY COUNT(b.Name) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(v.CreationDate) AS FirstVoteDate
FROM votes v
JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'chl';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NumberOfComments
FROM comments
WHERE PostId = (

    FROM posts
    WHERE Score = (SELECT MAX(Score) FROM posts)
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM posts
WHERE ViewCount > 35000

SELECT b.Name AS LatestBadge
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Emmett'
ORDER BY b.Date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(Id) AS NumAdultUsers
FROM users
WHERE Age BETWEEN 19 AND 65
  AND UpVotes > 5000;

SELECT 
    u.DisplayName,
    b.Name AS BadgeName,
    u.CreationDate AS AccountCreationDate,
    b.Date AS BadgeDate,
    julianday(b.Date) - julianday(u.CreationDate) AS DaysToBadge

JOIN users u

SELECT c.Text, u.DisplayName
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY c.CreationDate DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    Reputation,
    Views
FROM users
WHERE DisplayName = 'Jarrod Dixon';

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM comments c
     WHERE c.PostId = p.Id)                          AS CommentCount,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM posts a
     WHERE a.ParentId = p.Id
       AND a.PostTypeId = 2)                         AS AnswerCount
FROM posts p
WHERE p.Title = 'Clustering 1D data';

WITH stats_posts AS (
    SELECT posts.Id,
           posts.Score
    FROM posts
    JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
    WHERE users.Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users)
)
SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN stats_posts.Score > 50 THEN 1 END) / COUNT(stats_posts.Id) AS percentage
FROM stats_posts;

  AND Count <= 20;

SELECT c.Text

SELECT T1.CustomerID
FROM customers AS T1
JOIN yearmonth AS T5 ON T1.CustomerID = T5.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND T5.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
GROUP BY T1.CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(T5.Consumption) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID) AS NumCustomers
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
  AND y.Consumption < 30000;

SELECT c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY TotalConsumption ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    -- Total 2013 consumption per CZK customer, with their segment
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        y.CustomerID,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c
        ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    -- Lowest total consumption in each segment
    SELECT
        Segment,
        MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    -- The customer(s) with the least consumption in each segment
    SELECT
        z.Segment,
        SUM(z.total_consumption) AS total_consumption,
        COUNT(z.CustomerID)      AS num_customers
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN min_per_segment m
        ON z.Segment = m.Segment
       AND z.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY z.Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    -- Annual average = total consumption / number of lowest-consuming customers
    SELECT
        Segment,
        total_consumption * 1.0 / num_customers AS annual_avg_consumption
    FROM lowest
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT
    ROUND(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)

         SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
        ) * 100.0
        /
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0),
        2
    ) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    l.loan_id,
    l.amount                AS loan_amount,
    l.payments              AS monthly_payment,
    l.duration              AS duration_months,
    l.status,
    CASE l.status
        WHEN 'A' THEN 'Contract finished - paid without problems'
        WHEN 'B' THEN 'Contract finished - loan NOT paid (debt)'
        WHEN 'C' THEN 'Contract running - payments OK so far'
        WHEN 'D' THEN 'Contract running - client is in debt'
    END                     AS payment_status,
    -- rough remaining debt for a running loan:
    -- loan amount minus the monthly payments made so far
    l.amount - l.payments *
        CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(l.date)) / 30.44 AS INTEGER)
                            AS estimated_remaining_debt
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id  = c.client_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 992;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.IGG > 900
  AND T1.IGG < 2000
  AND T2.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T2.KCT = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'APS'
  AND L.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS num_patients

JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-')

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID

JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient

JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) < '2000';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT 
    1.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN p.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN l.ID END)

FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p 
    ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday) AS Youngest_Birthday

WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`)

SELECT Date
FROM Laboratory

ORDER BY ALB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS num_male_patients

  AND L.ALB < 5.5

SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) AS highest_ANA

SELECT E.ID

LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS num_patients

    ORDER BY TG DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS chlorine_molecule_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT
    1.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*)
           FROM bond b
           JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
           WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '-')
    /
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM atom a
     JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
     WHERE m.label = '+') AS avg_single_bonds;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 
       / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT a2.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY element ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
    - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'          -- molecule is not carcinogenic
  AND b.bond_type = '-'      -- bond is a single bond
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_id
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_id ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT 
    a.atom_id,
    a.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
        ELSE 'Non-carcinogenic'
    END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m 
    ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';

SELECT DISTINCT atom.element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id  FROM connected)
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041'
  AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY num_double_bonds DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.atom_id

JOIN connected AS T2

JOIN atom AS T3 
    ON T3.atom_id = T2.atom_id2

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected) AS percentage

JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id),
        5
    ) AS proportion
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m 
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.element)

     ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_single_bond_molecules

  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 
       / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent

SELECT

    label,
    CASE 
        WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Yes - carcinogenic'

    END AS is_carcinogenic

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';

SELECT a.atom_id

JOIN molecule AS m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

SELECT

JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b     ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'

SELECT COUNT(molecule_id)
FROM molecule

        SELECT molecule_id

        WHERE element = 's'
    )

        SELECT molecule_id

        WHERE bond_type = ' = '

SELECT m.label

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id

SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m

SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS num_atoms
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id

WITH avgs AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         SUM(y.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM,
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM,
  (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME;

SELECT mc.cnt * 100.0 / tt.total
FROM
  (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
   FROM bond
   JOIN connected ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
   JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = connected.atom_id
   JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = connected.atom_id2
   GROUP BY MIN(a1.element, a2.element), MAX(a1.element, a2.element)
   ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
   LIMIT 1) AS mc
JOIN
  (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
   FROM bond) AS tt;

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID, ym.Consumption AS Consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS minCons
    FROM czk
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT czk.Segment AS Segment, SUM(czk.Consumption) / COUNT(czk.CustomerID) AS annualAvg
    FROM czk
    JOIN mins ON czk.Segment = mins.Segment AND czk.Consumption = mins.minCons
    GROUP BY czk.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annualAvg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM per_customer
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT pc.Segment, SUM(pc.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(pc.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM per_customer pc
    JOIN min_per_segment mps ON pc.Segment = mps.Segment AND pc.total_consumption = mps.min_consumption
    GROUP BY pc.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;
