WITH czk_yearly AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_yearly
    GROUP BY Segment
),
segment_avg AS (
    SELECT cy.Segment, SUM(cy.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_yearly cy
    JOIN segment_min sm ON cy.Segment = sm.Segment AND cy.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY cy.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

SELECT T1.full_name

INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.race = 'Vampire'

FROM superhero

JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT SUM(height_cm) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS average_height FROM superhero;

SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE weight_kg = 0 OR weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT p.publisher_name FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.id = 38;

FROM superhero s

JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hero_id) FROM hero_attribute JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute ORDER BY attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race FROM superhero JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id WHERE superhero.id = 40

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm)
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_power JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id WHERE power_name = 'Intelligence'

FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T3 ON T1.id = T3.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T2 ON T3.power_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS in_patient,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS outpatient,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END), 2) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';
SELECT P.ID, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS Age FROM Patient AS P JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID WHERE E.RVVT = '+'
SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.ALB < 3.5;
SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG >= 200);

SELECT T1.`Date`, STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS' ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;
SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30'
SELECT E."aCL IgM" FROM Examination AS E JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND P.Description = '1994-02-19' AND E."Examination Date" = '1993/11/12'
SELECT T2.SEX FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.GPT = '9' AND T1.Date = '1992-06-12'
SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND `Examination Date` = '1997-01-27')
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Examination WHERE Thrombosis = 2 AND ANA = 'S' AND `aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS' AND T3.CRP > 2 AND T3.CRE = 1 AND T3.LDH = 123
SELECT T2.Symptoms FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' GROUP BY T2.Symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(T2.Symptoms) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473
SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997' AND T2.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET' AND T1.Admission = '-'

SELECT JULIANDAY(E.`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(P.`First Date`)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500
SELECT T1.ID, T2.ALP < 300 FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01'
SELECT Laboratory.TP - 8.5 FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5
SELECT * FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB <= 3.5 OR ALB >= 5.5) ORDER BY Birthday DESC
SELECT p.ID, CASE WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Albumin within normal range" FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(t.UA)
FROM (
    SELECT ID, UA, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
) t
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = t.ID
WHERE t.rn = 1
  AND ((p.SEX = 'M' AND t.UA < 8.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND t.UA < 6.5));
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND Laboratory.UN < 30
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' THEN T1.ID END) > COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' THEN T1.ID END) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
SELECT P.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L."T-BIL" >= 2.0 GROUP BY P.SEX
SELECT T1.ID, T1."T-CHO" FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory) ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND T2.FG NOT BETWEEN 150 AND 450
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2."U-PRO" > 0 AND T2."U-PRO" < 30 AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRP = '+' AND T1.Description IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE CAST(Laboratory.CRE AS REAL) >= 1.5 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 60;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis LIKE '%APS%' AND T2.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SM IN ('negative', '0') AND T2.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT DISTINCT e.ID FROM Examination e JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE e."Examination Date" > '1997-01-01' AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0') AND Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-') AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) < '2000'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.DNA < 8 AND T1.Description IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0 / COUNT(Laboratory.ID) FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(P.Birthday) FROM Patient AS P INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MIN(T1."First Date") FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH = (SELECT MAX(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500)
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5 AND T1.`aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%'
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TG < 200 ORDER BY T2.TG DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl'

SELECT SUM(bond.bond_type = '-') / COUNT(atom.atom_id) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE molecule.label = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT a.element FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON (a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2) WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.label = '-'
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element LIMIT 3
SELECT SUM(label = '+') - SUM(label = '-') FROM molecule;
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent FROM molecule;

SELECT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id LIMIT 3
SELECT bond_type FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_type ASC LIMIT 2
SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) t ON m.molecule_id = t.molecule_id
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#' AND T2.molecule_id = 'TR041'

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T2.atom_id FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id2 = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T3.element = 'pb' UNION SELECT DISTINCT T2.atom_id FROM connected AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id WHERE T3.element = 'pb'

SELECT COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
GROUP BY T2.element, T3.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT element) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-');
SELECT molecule_id, label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT element) = 2 FROM (
  SELECT a.element FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
  UNION
  SELECT a.element FROM connected c JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
) WHERE element IN ('cl', 'c')
SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2 FROM connected AS c JOIN bond AS b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) FROM bond INNER JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-'
SELECT b.bond_id, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
SELECT element, COUNT(element) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4' GROUP BY element
SELECT T2.label FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'ca'
SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = 'carcinogenic';
SELECT T2.molecule_id FROM connected AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND T2.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2'
SELECT atom.atom_id FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = ' = ' THEN 1 END) AS double_bonds, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS carcinogenic FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id) FROM connected AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl'

SELECT atom.atom_id, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.bond_type) FROM bond WHERE bond.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id) AS bond_type_count FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = 'TR346'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ')
SELECT molecule.label FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-'
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'
SELECT T2.molecule_id FROM connected AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND T1.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS is_carcinogenic FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';
SELECT DISTINCT T3.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T1.bond_type = ' = ' AND T3.element = 's'

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(atom.molecule_id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON (a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2)
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = '='

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-'

SELECT `frpm`.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `frpm`.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `eligible free rate`
FROM `frpm`
JOIN `schools` ON `frpm`.`CDSCode` = `schools`.`CDSCode`
WHERE `schools`.`SOCType` = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY `eligible free rate` ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT T2.School
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1
SELECT T2.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT T1.District
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY T1.District
ORDER BY AVG(T2.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(T1.cds)
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T2.County = 'Alameda'
  AND T1.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT s.sname, sc.CharterNum
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(t.AvgScrMath) > 400;

SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip
FROM schools AS T2
JOIN frpm AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.CDSCode
WHERE T2.City = 'Monterey'
  AND T1."School Type" = 'High Schools'
  AND T1."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType

WITH high_vision_players AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE vision > 89
),
match_players AS (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.name AS country
FROM high_vision_players hvp
JOIN match_players mp ON mp.player_api_id = hvp.player_api_id
JOIN Country c ON c.id = mp.country_id;

SELECT c.name AS country
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT country_id, player_api_id
    FROM (
        SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_api_id FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
    ) u
    WHERE player_api_id IS NOT NULL
) a
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = a.player_api_id
JOIN Country c ON c.id = a.country_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
  * 100.0
  / SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE d.account_id = l.account_id
      AND c.gender = 'M'
  );

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
minc AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM czk
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgc AS (
    SELECT cz.Segment,
           SUM(cz.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk cz
    JOIN minc m ON cz.Segment = m.Segment AND cz.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY cz.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgc WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';

FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id

WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*)

WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute ORDER BY attribute_value ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien'

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.weight_kg < 100 AND T2.colour = 'Brown'

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id

FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8;

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
         THEN 'in-patient' 
         ELSE 'outpatient' 
       END AS more_type,
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31'
SELECT ID, strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', Birthday) FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination WHERE RVVT = '+');

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON m.Segment = t.Segment AND m.min_consumption = t.total_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
JOIN expense AS T3 ON T1.member_id = T3.link_to_member
WHERE T3.approved = 'true'
  AND T3.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-01-10' AND '2019-11-19'
SELECT DISTINCT email FROM expense JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id WHERE expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19' AND cost > 20

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id WHERE member.position = 'Member' AND major.major_name = 'Education' AND major.college = 'College of Education & Human Services'
SELECT expense_description FROM expense GROUP BY expense_description HAVING SUM(cost) / COUNT(expense_id) > 50
SELECT SUM(T1.cost) / COUNT(T1.expense_id) FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id WHERE T2.position != 'Member'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY m.member_id
ORDER BY SUM(e.cost) DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone FROM member m WHERE m.member_id IN (SELECT e.link_to_member FROM expense e WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense))
SELECT T1.major_name, T1.department FROM major AS T1 JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major WHERE T2.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T2.last_name = 'Gerke'
SELECT last_name, phone FROM member INNER JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id WHERE major.major_name = 'Elementary Education'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, mj.college
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Secretary';

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent, e.event_name
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Speaker Gifts'
GROUP BY e.event_name;

SELECT z.city
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Garrett' AND m.last_name = 'Gerke'

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
GROUP BY s.id, s.full_name
HAVING COUNT(s.full_name) > 15;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue';
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = (SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') ORDER BY height_cm DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1

       COUNT(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Bad' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 END) AS marvel_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;
SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Star Trek'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE full_name IS NULL
SELECT c.colour FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id WHERE s.id = 75;
SELECT AVG(T1.weight_kg) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id WHERE T2.gender = 'Female'
SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id WHERE T2.race = 'Alien'
SELECT superhero.superhero_name FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id WHERE superhero.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND colour.colour = 'No Colour'

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE r.race = 'Demi-God'
LIMIT 5;

FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id

SELECT CAST(COUNT(superhero.id) AS REAL) / SUM(superhero.skin_colour_id = 1) FROM superhero

SELECT s.superhero_name, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler';
SELECT T1.height_cm FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Amber'

FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.skin_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.eye_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Gold';
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE race_id = (SELECT id FROM race WHERE race = 'Vampire');

SELECT SUM(height_cm) / COUNT(*) FROM superhero;
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE publisher_id = 1;

SELECT p.publisher_name FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE s.id = 38;

FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id

SELECT SUM(gender.id = 2) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id WHERE superhero.alignment_id = 2;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id WHERE T2.race <> 'Human' AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race FROM superhero JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id WHERE superhero.id = 40;
SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';
SELECT hero_power.hero_id FROM hero_power INNER JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id WHERE superpower.power_name = 'Intelligence'

SELECT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS in_patient,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS outpatient,
       CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'

SELECT P.ID, strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.RVVT = '+';

FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalCons
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
lowest_avg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.TotalCons) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM czk_2013 t
    WHERE t.TotalCons = (SELECT MIN(t2.TotalCons) FROM czk_2013 t2 WHERE t2.Segment = t.Segment)
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS Diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS Diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM lowest_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS Diff_KAM_SME;

        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match

        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
        UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match

WITH paid_2013 AS (
    -- Total CZK paid per customer per segment in 2013
    SELECT c.segment,
           s.cust_id,
           SUM(s.paid_czk) AS total_paid
    FROM consumption s
    JOIN customer c   ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id
    WHERE s.date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.segment, s.cust_id
),
min_paid AS (
    -- Lowest paid amount per segment
    SELECT segment, MIN(total_paid) AS min_paid
    FROM paid_2013
    GROUP BY segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    -- The customer(s) paying the least in each segment (handles ties)
    SELECT p.segment, p.cust_id
    FROM paid_2013 p
    JOIN min_paid m
      ON p.segment = m.segment
     AND p.total_paid = m.min_paid
),
avg_cons AS (
    -- Annual average consumption = total consumption / number of lowest-paying customers
    SELECT l.segment,
           SUM(s.consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT l.cust_id) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_customers l
    JOIN consumption s ON s.cust_id = l.cust_id
    WHERE s.date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY l.segment
)
-- Differences between segments
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END)
  - MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END)
  - MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END)
  - MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM avg_cons;

),
combo_counts AS (
    SELECT element1, element2, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY element1, element2
),
top_combos AS (
    SELECT element1, element2
    FROM combo_counts
    WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM combo_counts)   -- MAX(COUNT)
)
SELECT CAST(COUNT(be.bond_id) AS REAL) * 100          -- COUNT(bond_id) ...
       / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage    -- ... DIVIDED by total bonds
FROM bond_elements be
JOIN top_combos t
  ON be.element1 = t.element1 AND be.element2 = t.element2;

           consumption,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY segment
                        ORDER BY consumption ASC) AS rnk
    FROM consumption

mins AS (                                     -- lowest-consuming customers per segment
    SELECT segment,
           SUM(consumption) AS total_cons,
           COUNT(*)          AS n_cust

avgs AS (                                     -- annual average of that group

WITH cust AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS Consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS mincons FROM cust GROUP BY Segment
),
seg AS (
    SELECT cust.Segment, SUM(cust.Consumption) / COUNT(*) AS avgcons
    FROM cust
    JOIN lowest ON cust.Segment = lowest.Segment AND cust.Consumption = lowest.mincons
    GROUP BY cust.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avgcons FROM seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avgcons FROM seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT avgcons FROM seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avgcons FROM seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT avgcons FROM seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avgcons FROM seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

    (df["Low Grade"] == "K") &

filtered["Percent Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"] = (
    filtered["FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"] / 
    filtered["Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"]
) * 100

WITH yearly AS (               -- total 2013 consumption of each CZK-paying customer
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_cons
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
mins AS (                      -- lowest total consumption within each segment
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_cons) AS min_cons
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (                    -- annual average of the lowest-consumption customers
    SELECT y.Segment,
           SUM(y.total_cons) / COUNT(y.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM yearly y
    JOIN mins m
      ON m.Segment = y.Segment AND m.min_cons = y.total_cons
    GROUP BY y.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
  - (SELECT annual_avg FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

## Most Common Connections

| Bond | Description | Typical context |
|------|-------------|-----------------|
| **C – C** | Carbon–carbon single bonds | Aliphatic chains, simple saturated rings |
| **C – H** | Carbon–hydrogen bonds | Saturated hydrocarbons |
| **C – O** | Carbon–oxygen bonds | Alcohols, ethers, carboxylic acids |
| **C – N** | Carbon–nitrogen bonds | Simple amines, amides |
| **O – H / N – H** | Hydroxyl/amine groups | Polar functional groups |

## Key Observations

- **Carbon (C)** is the most frequent atom, almost always connected via **single bonds** in non-carcinogenic molecules.
- **Oxygen (O)** and **Nitrogen (N)** appear mainly attached to simple carbon chains rather than aromatic ring systems.
- Non-carcinogenic structures tend to be **saturated, acyclic (chain-like) molecules** with few heteroatoms.

## Contrast with Carcinogenic Molecules (label = '+')

Carcinogenic molecules typically show connections that are *rare* in the non-carcinogenic class:

- **N – O** bonds (nitro groups, –NO₂)
- **Aromatic ring** bonds (delocalized C=C in benzene/polycyclic systems)
- **C – Cl / C – Br** bonds (halogenated aromatics)
- **N = N** (azo linkages)

**Summary:** In non-carcinogenic molecules, atoms are predominantly connected through **C–C single bonds** with light heteroatoms (O, N) attached to aliphatic chains, lacking the nitro-aromatic and halogenated ring motifs characteristic of carcinogenic compounds.

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff;

WITH combos AS (
  SELECT c.bond_id,
         MIN(a1.element, a2.element) || '-' || MAX(a1.element, a2.element) AS combo
  FROM connected c
  JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
),
counts AS (
  SELECT combo, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM combos
  GROUP BY combo
),
most_common AS (
  SELECT combo
  FROM counts
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM combos WHERE combo = (SELECT combo FROM most_common))
     / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond);

WITH min_cons AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, MIN(y.Consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
avg_cons AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) / COUNT(y.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    JOIN min_cons m ON m.Segment = c.Segment AND y.Consumption = m.min_consumption
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS difference_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS difference_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_cons WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS difference_KAM_SME

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN combo = (
    SELECT combo FROM (
        SELECT CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a1.element || a2.element ELSE a2.element || a1.element END AS combo
        FROM connected c
        JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
        JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    ) GROUP BY combo ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
) THEN 1 END) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)
FROM (
    SELECT c.bond_id, CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a1.element || a2.element ELSE a2.element || a1.element END AS combo
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY c.bond_id, combo
)

JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541;

SELECT 
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) 
        / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage_female
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 > 10000;

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '97' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
       * 100.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 2) = '96' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M';

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'north Bohemia' THEN CAST(A16 AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN A3 = 'east Bohemia' THEN CAST(A16 AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS crime_difference
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT l.amount - SUM(t.amount) AS debt, l.status
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id AND t.k_symbol = 'UROV'
WHERE c.client_id = 992
GROUP BY l.amount, l.status;

SELECT SUM(T.amount)

JOIN disp AS D ON C.client_id = D.client_id

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id)

SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID 
FROM Patient 
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0 
  AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30 
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE Description IS NULL 
  AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE CRP = '+');
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(T1.Birthday)) < 70

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.RA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND T3.KCT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(T1.Birthday)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3.Thrombosis = 2 AND T2.C4 > 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-') AND YEAR(T1.`First Date`) < 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN Laboratory.ID END) * 1.0 / COUNT(Laboratory.ID)
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT MAX(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 WHERE T1.ID IN (SELECT T2.ID FROM Laboratory AS T2 WHERE T2.GOT >= 60)
SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH < 500 GROUP BY T1.ID ORDER BY MAX(T2.LDH) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY ALB DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
  AND T3.`aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG < 200
ORDER BY T2.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM bond b
   JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
   WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '-') * 1.0
  /
  (SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id)
   FROM atom a
   JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
   WHERE m.label = '+') AS avg_single_bonded;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(atom.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM atom
WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT bond.molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond.bond_type = '='
);

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR000'
ORDER BY a.element
LIMIT 3;
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '-') AS difference;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent
FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND b.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T2.bond_type, T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT element
FROM atom
WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)
  AND atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected);

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#' AND T2.molecule_id = 'TR041'

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
WHERE T2.element = 'pb';

SELECT MAX(cnt) * 100.0 / SUM(cnt) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(c.bond_id) AS cnt
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    GROUP BY a1.element, a2.element
) t;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002');

SELECT CASE
         WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
          AND SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
         THEN 'yes'
         ELSE 'no'
       END AS result
FROM (
    SELECT a.element
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT a.element
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
) t;

SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id)
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(atom.element)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'ca';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT T1.molecule_id 
FROM molecule AS T1 
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id 
WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T3.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT T1.atom_id FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'c' AND T2.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bond_count, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT connected.bond_id)
FROM connected
JOIN atom AS a1 ON connected.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON connected.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T2.bond_type)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE T3.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY T1.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's')
  AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'c'
  AND molecule.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
INNER JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 'o' AND T3.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT frpm."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" * 1.0 / frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
  AND frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.School
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE st.NumTstTakr > 500 AND s.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT "CDSCode" FROM frpm WHERE "Enrollment (K-12)" + "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 500

SELECT s.District
FROM satscores st
JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(st.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Alameda' AND T1.StatusType = 'Merged' AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS rank, sc.CharterNum, s.sname, s.AvgScrWrite
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND sc.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrWrite DESC;

SELECT T2.School, T2.FundingType
FROM schools AS T2
JOIN (
    SELECT cds, AVG(AvgScrMath) AS avg_math
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY cds
) AS T ON T.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Riverside' AND T.avg_math > 400

SELECT T2.School, T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`County Name` = 'Monterey'
  AND T1.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800
  AND T1.`High Grade` = 12;

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOC
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
      SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
      FROM frpm AS T3
      INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode
      WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT "Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / "Enrollment (K-12)" AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;

SELECT T2.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE (T1.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson')
   OR (T1.AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName2 = 'Gibson')
   OR (T1.AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND T1.AdmLName3 = 'Gibson');

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(T2.NumTstTakr)
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Fresno'
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.School
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.DOC = 31
ORDER BY T2."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sname, MailStreet
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores INNER JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.MailCity = 'Lakeport' AND satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite >= 1500

FROM schools
WHERE ((AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson') OR
       (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson') OR
       (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson'))

SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND County = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND T2.Charter = 0
  AND T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools 
WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded' 
  AND County = 'Stanislaus' 
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31';
SELECT County FROM schools WHERE SOC = 11 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989 GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.School,
       f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" * 100.0 / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode

SELECT GSserved
FROM schools
WHERE City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT City, GSserved, School FROM schools WHERE State = 'CA' ORDER BY Latitude ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(T2.City), T2.City
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.Magnet = 1

SELECT T2."District Code", T2."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / T2."Enrollment (K-12)" AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine';

FROM users u

    FROM comments

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Announcer'

SELECT c.Text

WITH czk2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID, ym.Consumption AS Consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    INNER JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
mincons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_cons
    FROM czk2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT f.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(f.Consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(f.CustomerID) AS avg_cons
    FROM czk2013 AS f
    JOIN mincons AS m ON m.Segment = f.Segment AND m.min_cons = f.Consumption
    GROUP BY f.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_cons FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_cons FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_cons FROM lowest WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

FROM account

WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice' AND account.date LIKE '96%';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE lower(d.type) = 'owner'

  AND (substr(a.date, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1995' AND '2000'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id)

SELECT d.A3 FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.client_id = 3541

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN c.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS pct_women
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 > 10000;

SELECT ((SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount END)) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
WHERE l.account_id IN (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
)
AND strftime('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997');
SELECT (SELECT SUM(CAST(A16 AS INTEGER)) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'north Bohemia') - (SELECT SUM(CAST(A16 AS INTEGER)) FROM district WHERE A3 = 'east Bohemia') AS crime_difference;

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)
   FROM Laboratory l
   JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
   WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA IS NOT NULL AND l.UA != '' AND CAST(l.UA AS REAL) <= 8.0) * 1.0

  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)
   FROM Laboratory l
   JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
   WHERE p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA IS NOT NULL AND l.UA != '' AND CAST(l.UA AS REAL) <= 6.5) AS male_to_female_ratio;
