SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND T1.Admission = '-'

SELECT julianday(MIN(e."Examination Date")) - julianday(p."First Date") AS days_until_evaluation
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01'

SELECT L.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND (T2.ALB <= 3.5 OR T2.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID, CASE WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Albumin within normal range"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT AVG(l.UA)
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.Date = (
    SELECT MAX(l2.Date)
    FROM Laboratory l2
    WHERE l2.ID = l.ID
)
AND (
    (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA < 8.0)
    OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA < 6.5)
);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT SUM(p.SEX = 'M') > SUM(p.SEX = 'F')
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.SEX,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS PATIENTS
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT l.ID, l."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY l."T-CHO" DESC, p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (CAST(L.FG AS REAL) < 150 OR CAST(L.FG AS REAL) > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."U-PRO" >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory."U-PRO" > 0
  AND Laboratory."U-PRO" < 30
  AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRP = '+' AND P.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE CAST(T2.CRE AS REAL) >= 1.5 
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.RF IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.KCT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RF < 20
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 60;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2 AND L.C4 > 10;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND T3.Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT DISTINCT E.ID FROM Examination E JOIN Laboratory L ON E.ID = L.ID WHERE E."Examination Date" > '1997-01-01' AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND Examination.Symptoms IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SSA IN ('-', '+-') AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) < 2000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8
  AND Patient.Description IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN P.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(L.ID) AS percentage
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH < 500
GROUP BY T1.ID
ORDER BY MAX(T2.LDH) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE CAST(ALB AS REAL) > 3.5 AND CAST(ALB AS REAL) < 5.5 ORDER BY CAST(ALB AS REAL) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.ALB > 3.5
  AND T2.ALB < 5.5
  AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5;
SELECT E.ID FROM Examination AS E INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID WHERE L.CRE < 1.5 ORDER BY E."aCL IgA" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0
  AND e."ANA Pattern" LIKE '%P%';

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG < 200
ORDER BY L.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.atom_id)
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
INNER JOIN molecule AS T4 ON T4.molecule_id = T1.molecule_id
WHERE T4.label = '+'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percentage_carbon
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
);

SELECT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'
UNION
SELECT a.element
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element LIMIT 3;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM molecule;
SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) AS percent FROM molecule;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY bond_type
LIMIT 2;

SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2
FROM bond AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label, CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'not carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10';
SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR004';

SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
FROM molecule
WHERE molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = ' = '
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected);

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND b.molecule_id = 'TR041';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN atom pb ON pb.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE pb.element = 'pb'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom pb ON pb.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE pb.element = 'pb';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)
FROM (
    SELECT c.bond_id,
           MIN(a1.element, a2.element) AS e1,
           MAX(a1.element, a2.element) AS e2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY c.bond_id
) t
GROUP BY e1, e2
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id), 5) AS percentage
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element)
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';
SELECT molecule_id, label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002');

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT element) = 2 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
WHERE connected.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' AND element IN ('cl', 'c');

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT b.bond_id,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT atom.element, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY atom.element;

SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN molecule.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END AS carcinogenic_status
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'ca';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+';
SELECT T1.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T2.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS num_double_bonds, m.label AS carcinogenic
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR006' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c1.bond_id)
FROM connected c1
JOIN connected c2 ON c1.bond_id = c2.bond_id AND c1.atom_id = c2.atom_id2
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c2.atom_id2
WHERE a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT a.atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS bond_type_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR346'
GROUP BY a.atom_id;

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT a1.molecule_id
FROM atom a1
JOIN atom a2 ON a1.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1';
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.element = 's' AND T3.bond_type = ' = '

SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
ORDER BY COUNT(atom.atom_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.DOCType = 'Continuation School' ORDER BY T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT s.sname FROM satscores s JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 500 AND sc.Magnet = 1
SELECT T2.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT `CDSCode` FROM frpm WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500
SELECT T1.dname FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.StatusType = 'Active' GROUP BY T1.dname ORDER BY AVG(T1.AvgScrRead) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode) FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T1.County = 'Alameda' AND T1.StatusType = 'Merged' AND T2.NumTstTakr < 100

SELECT satscores.sname, schools.CharterNum FROM schools JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds WHERE satscores.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND schools.CharterNum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY satscores.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.cname = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY s.School, s.FundingType
HAVING AVG(t.AvgScrMath) > 400

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Monterey' AND f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT T2.School, T2.DOCType FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND (T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > ( SELECT AVG(T3.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T3.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm AS T3 INNER JOIN schools AS T4 ON T3.CDSCode = T4.CDSCode WHERE T4.FundingType = 'Locally funded' )
SELECT frpm.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` FROM schools INNER JOIN frpm ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode ORDER BY frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

SELECT T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Eligible free rates for students aged 5-17` FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND T2.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson'
SELECT T2.AdmEmail1 FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 ORDER BY T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(T1.NumTstTakr) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno' AND strftime('%Y', T2.OpenDate) = '1980'
SELECT T1.AvgScrWrite, T2.City FROM satscores AS T1 JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.School FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.DOC = 31 ORDER BY T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT sname, MailStreet FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode ORDER BY AvgScrMath DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode WHERE (satscores.AvgScrRead + satscores.AvgScrMath + satscores.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500 AND schools.MailCity = 'Lakeport'

SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez')
SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE Virtual = 'P' AND Charter = 1 AND County = 'San Joaquin'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools AS T1 JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.County = 'Los Angeles' AND T1.Charter = 0 AND T2.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE FundingType = 'Directly Funded' AND County = 'Stanislaus' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31'
SELECT County FROM schools WHERE SOC = 11 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', ClosedDate) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989 GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(CDSCode) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.School, T2.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` / T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` * 100 FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.GSserved = 'K-9' AND T1.County = 'Los Angeles'
SELECT GSserved FROM schools WHERE City = 'Adelanto' GROUP BY GSserved ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.City, T1.`Low Grade`, T2.School FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.State = 'CA' ORDER BY T2.Latitude ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.City, COUNT(T2.CDSCode) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Magnet = 1 AND T2.GSserved = 'K-8' AND T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' GROUP BY T2.City

SELECT schools.`District`, frpm.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / frpm.`Enrollment (K-12)` * 100 AS `Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`, frpm.`District Code` FROM frpm INNER JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode WHERE schools.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2, AdmEmail3 FROM schools WHERE County = 'San Bernardino' AND City = 'San Bernardino' AND District = 'San Bernardino City Unified' AND OpenDate BETWEEN '1/1/2009' AND '12/31/2010' AND SOC = 62 AND DOC = 54 AND AdmEmail1 IS NOT NULL AND AdmEmail2 IS NOT NULL AND AdmEmail3 IS NOT NULL
SELECT DisplayName FROM users ORDER BY Views DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT p.Title FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
SELECT MAX(AnswerCount) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie')

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;
SELECT posts.Body FROM tags JOIN posts ON tags.ExcerptPostId = posts.Id WHERE tags.TagName = 'bayesian'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM badges JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id WHERE users.DisplayName = 'csgillespie' AND strftime('%Y', badges.Date) = '2011'
SELECT AVG(p.Score) FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE PostId IN (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE ViewCount = 1910)

SELECT c.Text
FROM posts p
JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ParentId = 107829
  AND p.CommentCount = 1;
SELECT DISTINCT UserDisplayName FROM comments WHERE Text = 'thank you user93!'

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data'
SELECT SUM(v.BountyAmount) FROM votes v JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data%'
SELECT u.DisplayName FROM votes v JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id WHERE v.BountyAmount = 50 AND p.Title LIKE '%variance%'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u WHERE u.Location LIKE '%New York%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges b WHERE b.UserId = u.Id AND b.Name = 'Teacher') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM badges b2 WHERE b2.UserId = u.Id AND b2.Name = 'Supporter');

SELECT users.Id, users.DisplayName FROM users JOIN postHistory ON users.Id = postHistory.UserId WHERE users.Views >= 1000 GROUP BY users.Id, users.DisplayName HAVING COUNT(postHistory.PostId) = COUNT(DISTINCT postHistory.PostId)

SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName, b.Name AS BadgeName
FROM users u
JOIN comments c ON c.UserId = u.Id
JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName, b.Name
HAVING COUNT(c.Id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(Id) AS cnt
        FROM comments

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
mins AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM totals t
    JOIN mins m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,

SELECT MIN(T1.`First Date`) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500 ORDER BY LDH DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT T1.`Examination Date` FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 ORDER BY T2.ALB DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.ALB > 3.5 AND T2.ALB < 5.5 AND T2.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5
SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5 ORDER BY T3."aCL IgA" DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%'
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200 ORDER BY TG DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.molecule_id) FROM atom INNER JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND atom.element = 'cl'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(atom.atom_id) FROM atom JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+'
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(element = 'c') / COUNT(atom_id) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '=')
SELECT a1.element, a2.element FROM connected c JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9'

SELECT T3.atom_id, T3.atom_id2
FROM molecule AS T1
JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T1.label = '-'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY element ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM molecule
SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(molecule_id), 3) FROM molecule

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id JOIN connected ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-' ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3
SELECT bond_type FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR006' ORDER BY bond_type ASC LIMIT 2
SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'
SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label FROM atom a JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR001_10'
SELECT atom.element FROM atom WHERE atom.molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS is_carcinogenic FROM molecule m WHERE m.molecule_id = (SELECT b.molecule_id FROM bond b WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY b.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT DISTINCT a.element FROM atom a WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected) AND a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected)
SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2 FROM connected c JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#'
SELECT b.molecule_id FROM bond b JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY b.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.atom_id2 FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.element = 'pb'

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id GROUP BY T2.element, T3.element ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(molecule.label = '+') * 100.0 / COUNT(bond.bond_id), 5) FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.element) FROM atom AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '-'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id IN ('TR000', 'TR001', 'TR002')

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT element) = 2 THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END FROM atom WHERE element IN ('cl', 'c') AND (atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_8') OR atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'))
SELECT T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 FROM connected AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '#'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND molecule.label = '-';
SELECT T1.bond_id, CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' ELSE 'non-carcinogenic' END FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#'
SELECT count(atom.element) FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' AND substr(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
SELECT T2.label FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'ca'
SELECT SUM(bond_type = ' = ') * 100.0 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR047'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR151'
SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+'
SELECT T2.molecule_id FROM connected AS T1 JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND T1.atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT atom.atom_id FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.element = 'c' AND molecule.label = '-'

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS double_bonds, m.label AS carcinogenic FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = ' = ' WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY m.label;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.bond_id) FROM connected AS T1 JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id WHERE T2.element = 'cl' AND T3.element = 'cl'

SELECT T1.atom_id, COUNT(T3.bond_type) FROM atom AS T1 JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = 'TR346' GROUP BY T1.atom_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 's') AND molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ');
SELECT molecule.label FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'cl' AND m.label = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'c' AND m.label = '-'
SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_1_7'
SELECT a1.molecule_id FROM atom AS a1 JOIN atom AS a2 ON a1.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4'
SELECT element FROM atom WHERE atom_id = 'TR000_1'
SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR000'
SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id FROM atom a JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
SELECT molecule.molecule_id FROM molecule JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id WHERE molecule.label = '+' GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(atom.atom_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) FROM atom a JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = ' = '
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) FROM bond JOIN molecule ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '#' AND molecule.label = '-'
